这座城市地位日益重要。意大利耶稣会士利玛窦于1583年在此定居，并刊印了中文世界地图；从16世纪中叶到1746年，两广总督府设在肇庆。1646年，南明永历帝在这座城中即位，1648年至1650年间朝廷又在这里驻跸。高要的土地陆续划出，形成邻近县份：1475年设高明县，1526年部分划入三水，1577年部分划入东安。

english: Gāoyóu stands beside the Grand Canal and the lake that bears its name, in the low country between the Yangtze and Huái rivers. Its position made it a key point on the water route north. In 1353 the salt trader Zhāng Shìchéng rose against the Yuán and captured towns in the region. The following year he proclaimed himself king at Gāoyóu, naming his state Great Zhōu. His forces intercepted grain traffic on the canal, drawing a major imperial army against the town.
simp_chinese: 高邮位于江淮之间的低地，濒临大运河与同名湖泊，是北上水路的重要地点。1353年，盐贩张士诚起兵反元，攻取附近城镇。次年，他在高邮称王，国号大周。其部众截断运河漕运，引来元朝大军围攻。

english: Gāoyóu Lake lies beside the Grand Canal in the lowlands between the Huái and Yangtze rivers. Its waters were closely tied to the embankments that protected the canal. In 1575 a breach in the Hóngzé Lake dyke sent floodwater into Gāoyóu Lake, breaking canal banks and inundating the Lǐxiàhé region.
simp_chinese: 高邮湖位于江淮低地的大运河旁，湖水与保护运河的堤防息息相关。明万历三年（1575年），洪泽湖大堤决口，洪水涌入高邮湖，冲破运河堤岸，淹没里下河地区。

english:
Gaoyuan was the county at the seat of Yuan Xinghe Circuit, in the country of present-day Zhangbei. Its earlier name was Rouyuan; under the Mongols it became Gaoyuan, serving the administration first called Longxing and renamed Xinghe in 1312. The town lay on the route towards Shangdu, and Yuan rulers travelling between their capitals stopped in this frontier country.

Ming conquest transformed its role. Li Wenzhong took Xinghe in 1370, and Lan Yu defeated Mongol forces there in 1374. The county organisation disappeared in the early Ming, while Xinghe became a heavily defended guard post paired with Kaiping beyond the main passes. This exposed position proved difficult to retain. In 1422 Arughtai's forces captured the town; the guard establishment was moved inside Xuanfu and the old site abandoned. Gaoyuan's changing fortunes followed the retreat of a former circuit capital into an increasingly militarised and contested frontier.
simp_chinese:
高原是元代兴和路的治县，地在今张北一带。其前身名柔远，蒙古统治下改称高原，成为隆兴路的治所；1312年，隆兴路更名兴和路。这里处在通往上都的道路上，元朝皇帝往来两都时曾在这一边地驻跸。

明朝征服使其职能发生改变。1370年李文忠攻取兴和，1374年蓝玉又在此击败蒙古军队。高原县在明初废除，兴和则改为重兵驻守的守御据点，与开平共同构成关外防御。这样突出于主防线之外的位置难以长期维持。1422年，阿鲁台军队攻陷兴和，守御机构迁入宣府城，原址遂被放弃。高原从一路治所变为军事边城，再因防线收缩而失去原有地位，其兴衰紧贴着元明之间边疆秩序的变化。

english:
Gaoyuan stood within the low-lying country affected by the Xiaoqing River and the waters descending from the hills of central Shandong. Flooding linked its fortunes to neighbouring Zouping, Zhangqiu, Boxing and Le'an. Waterways that served one district could spread damage across several others, making drainage a problem that extended well beyond the county boundary.

In 1544 renewed silting and flooding prompted the appointment of Chen Gui to investigate the river system. His examination identified water arriving from the Luo River and converging at Jiaya Bay as a major cause of inundation around Gaoyuan. Rather than treating navigation as the overriding objective, he considered diverting this flow westward. An older channel, the Zhimaigou, had been opened from Gaoyuan during the Chenghua reign. By Chen's time parts lay under floodwater and others had become fields, so he advised against simply reopening its former course. Gaoyuan's sixteenth-century history thus records competing choices about rivers, cultivated land and the practical limits of restoring earlier hydraulic works.
simp_chinese:
高苑位于小清河及山东中部山地来水影响的低洼地区，水患将其命运同邹平、章丘、博兴、乐安连接起来。流经某县的水道，也可能给几个邻县造成灾害，排水因而成为超出一县边界的问题。

1544年，河道再次淤塞、水患复发，陈珪受命调查治理。他将漯河来水在驾鸭湾一带汇集，视为高苑附近泛滥的重要原因，考虑将这股水西引，而不以恢复通航为首要目标。另一条支脉沟曾于成化年间自高苑开出，但到陈珪勘查时，部分已经淹没，部分淤为农田，因此他主张不必照旧重开。高苑十六世纪的地方经历，由此呈现出治河中的具体取舍：河道的变迁、农田的利用与旧水利工程能否恢复，必须放在同一片相互牵连的水系中考虑。

english: Gap stands among the southern Alps, where roads from Grenoble and Provence meet. Its position brought travellers and trade but also exposed the bishop's town to armies crossing the mountains. In 1692 Victor Amadeus of Savoy led an invasion of upper Dauphiné, taking Guillestre, Embrun and Gap. The town was burned during the campaign, yet its place at an Alpine crossroads ensured its recovery after the invaders withdrew.
simp_chinese: 加普坐落在南阿尔卑斯山中，格勒诺布尔与普罗旺斯的道路在此汇合。交通位置带来了旅人和贸易，也使这座主教城暴露于翻山越岭的军队面前。1692年，萨伏依的维托里奥·阿梅代奥入侵上多菲内，攻占吉耶斯特尔、昂布兰和加普。城镇在战役中被焚毁，但阿尔卑斯交通要冲的地位使它在入侵者撤退后得以复苏。

english:
Gapsan developed as a fortified district in Korea's northeastern mountains. In 1391 the late Goryeo government incorporated the territory as Gapju and established a military command. Early Joseon rulers sought to bring its substantial Jurchen population under royal authority. The district received the name Gapsan in 1413; two years later a county magistrate replaced the military commander, combining civil administration with frontier defence.

Distance from Gilju helped make Gapsan an independent garrison in 1455. In 1461 Han Myeonghoe argued that its exposed position and weak forces required an experienced, higher-ranking official. Gapsan consequently became a protectorate, whose magistrate also commanded its troops, with a subordinate commander at Unchong Fort. Later military reorganizations altered the garrison's responsibilities, but local government and military command remained closely joined.
simp_chinese:
甲山是朝鲜东北山地的设防行政区。1391年，高丽末期政府将这一地区纳入统治，改称甲州并设置万户府。朝鲜王朝初期又着力使当地众多女真居民归附王权。1413年，甲州改名甲山；两年后以知郡事取代万户，地方行政与边防军务由同一官员兼理。

甲山距离吉州较远，1455年成为独立的军镇。1461年，韩明浍指出这里形势孤立、兵力薄弱，需要更有经验、品级更高的官员主持，遂促成甲山升为都护府。都护府使兼任军事长官，统率驻军，云宠堡另设万户负责防守。此后地方军制虽有调整，甲山的行政与军事职权仍紧密结合，边疆官员既要治理居民，也要维持堡垒及部队的运转。

english:
Gapyeong lay on the boundary between two of Joseon Korea's provinces. In 1413 it was transferred from Gangwon to Gyeonggi, and a hyeongam, or local magistrate, was appointed. Its rank changed repeatedly during the dynasty: the hyeon was raised to a gun in 1507, reduced to a hyeon in 1697, and restored to gun status in 1707.

The name itself was older than Joseon. It had been adopted in 757 under Unified Silla, and in 1018 the district became subordinate to Chunju, today's Chuncheon. The early Joseon transfer therefore redirected an established district from the provincial system centred on Chuncheon into Gyeonggi, the province surrounding the royal capital.
simp_chinese:
嘉平位于朝鲜王朝两个道的交界地区。1413年，这里从江原道划入京畿道，并设现监治理。其行政等级在王朝时期屡有变化：1507年由县升郡，1697年降为县，1707年再次升郡。

嘉平之名比朝鲜王朝更古老，统一新罗于757年采用这一名称；1018年，这里成为春州，即今春川的属郡。因此，朝鲜初年的改隶，把一个既有的地方行政区从以春川为中心的体系划入环绕王都的京畿道。

english: Garabito was a powerful Huetar ruler in western Costa Rica at the time of the Spanish conquest. His authority extended across the Aguacate hills and the plains toward the Pacific coast, and his name became associated with the western Huetar polity. When Juan de Cavallón entered the region in 1561, Garabito opposed the newcomers. His resistance became one of the best-known episodes of the long Spanish conquest of Costa Rica’s Central Valley and Pacific hinterland.
simp_chinese: 加拉维托是西班牙征服时期哥斯达黎加西部一位强大的韦塔尔首领。他的势力遍及阿瓜卡特山岭和通向太平洋海岸的平原，其名字也与西部韦塔尔政体联系在一起。1561年，胡安·德·卡瓦永进入该地区时，加拉维托抵抗了这些外来者。他的抗争成为西班牙长期征服哥斯达黎加中央谷地及太平洋腹地过程中最为人熟知的篇章之一。

english: Garacad lies on the Indian Ocean coast of central Somalia, where dry inland grazing country approaches the sea. The shoreline is exposed to winds and currents that change with the monsoon. Fishing and coastal sailing connect communities here with the waters of the western Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 加拉卡德位于索马里中部印度洋海岸，干燥的内陆牧区在这里延伸至海边。海岸面向随季风变化的风与洋流。捕鱼与沿岸航行将当地社群与西印度洋水域联系起来。

english: Garadoumé lies in the Sahelian country of Ader, west of the Aïr Mountains. The region forms a transition between the Sahara to the north and the more densely settled lands to the south. Seasonal rains sustain grazing and cultivation across a landscape of dry valleys, scattered settlements and open ground.
simp_chinese: 加拉杜梅位于阿伊尔山以西的阿德尔萨赫勒地区。这里是北方撒哈拉与南方较密集定居地区之间的过渡地带。季节性降雨维系着牧场和耕作，干河谷、散落的聚落与开阔地面共同构成当地景观。

english: Garafraxa lies in the wooded country north of the Grand River, where the origins of the place name have attracted several explanations. The township was opened to settlement in the 1820s. Among those granted land were Richard Pierpoint, a Black veteran of the War of 1812, and other Black families. In 1833 settlers travelling through Garafraxa and Eramosa reached a site on the Grand River that became Fergus, adding another settlement to the country being opened along the river.
simp_chinese: 加拉弗拉沙位于格兰德河以北的森林地区，地名的来历有多种解释。十九世纪二十年代，这片乡区开始向移民开放。获得土地的人包括1812年战争的黑人退伍军人理查德·皮尔波因特及其他黑人家庭。1833年，一批移民穿过加拉弗拉沙和埃拉莫萨，到达格兰德河边后来成为弗格斯的地方，沿河开发的地区又增添了一处聚落。

english: Garalo lies in southern Mali, in the savanna country between the upper Niger and the lands towards the forest. The region belongs to a long-established network of Manding communities. Fields, woodland and seasonal streams form the setting of settlements south of the great inland bend of the Niger.
simp_chinese: 加拉洛位于马里南部，坐落在尼日尔河上游与南方森林地带之间的稀树草原中。这片地区属于历史悠久的曼丁社群网络。田地、林地与季节性河流共同构成了尼日尔河巨大内陆河曲以南的聚落环境。

english: Garandoili lies in the western Bornu country, south of the Komadugu Yobe and east of Nguru. The river flows toward Lake Chad, while Nguru stood on the routes between Bornu and the Hausa lands. From the seventeenth century the Galadima, or warden of the west, held his seat at Nguru and governed Bornu's western marches. His authority connected the surrounding settlements with the court farther east.
simp_chinese: 加兰多伊利位于博尔努西部，在科马杜古约贝河以南、恩古鲁以东。河水向乍得湖流去，恩古鲁则坐落在博尔努与豪萨地区之间的道路上。自十七世纪起，负责西部边疆的加拉迪马以恩古鲁为治所，治理博尔努的西部属地，将周围聚落与更东面的宫廷联系起来。

english:
Garbahare lies in the Gedo country of southern Somalia, west of the Jubba River near the Ethiopian and Kenyan borderlands. Dry grassland, scattered acacia and seasonal wells support camel, cattle, sheep and goats. Tracks cross a broad semi-arid plain, and rain determines where herders and their animals can remain.

The region formed part of the medieval Ajuran sphere, whose authority extended across much of southern Somalia and eastern Ethiopia. In the later pre-industrial period, Garbahare belonged within the Geledi Sultanate, which linked riverine towns and pastoral clans through trade, justice and military alliances. Local lineages governed wells and grazing, while caravans carried livestock, hides, grain and cloth toward Jubba markets and the coast.

Garbahare remained an inland center of clan and district authority rather than a major port. Its importance came from water, pasture and routes across Gedo’s dry plains. At the beginning of the nineteenth century, these southern Somali networks still connected the interior to the Jubba valley and Indian Ocean commerce.
simp_chinese:
加尔巴哈雷位于索马里南部盖多地区，处在朱巴河以西，靠近埃塞俄比亚和肯尼亚边境。干旱草原、零散金合欢和季节水井支持骆驼、牛、绵羊与山羊。道路穿越广阔半干旱平原，降雨决定牧民和牲畜能够停留的位置。

地区属于中世纪阿朱兰势力范围，其权威扩展至索马里南部和埃塞俄比亚东部大部分地区。近代早期，加尔巴哈雷进入格莱迪苏丹国的影响，后者通过贸易、司法与军事联盟连接河畔城镇和牧民氏族。地方世系管理水井与草场，商队则把牲畜、兽皮、谷物和布匹运往朱巴河市场及海岸。

加尔巴哈雷始终是内陆氏族与县域权威中心，而非大港。其重要性来自盖多旱原上的水源、牧场和道路。十九世纪初，这些南部索马里网络仍把内地同朱巴河谷及印度洋贸易连接起来。水井维系着道路。

english: Gardelegen grew below a castle in the Altmark and was first recorded as a town and fortress in 1196. Its position at a crossroads favoured trade, and in 1358 it was invited to the Hanseatic assembly at Lübeck. Brewing became a source of wealth, but a beer tax imposed by Elector John Cicero in 1488 provoked resistance. Three of its leaders were executed, and Gardelegen was forbidden to remain in town alliances. From around 1500 its brewers exported Garley, a strong herbal drink, to distant markets. The export tax helped finance buildings including the town hall and Salzwedel Gate. Brewing declined in the early eighteenth century, and Gardelegen became a garrison town in 1725.
simp_chinese: 加尔德莱根在阿尔特马克一座城堡下发展，1196年首次作为城镇和堡垒见于记载。道路交汇的位置有利于贸易，1358年它受邀参加吕贝克的汉萨会议。酿酒带来财富，但约翰·齐塞罗选帝侯于1488年征收啤酒税，引发抵抗。三名领头者被处死，加尔德莱根也被禁止继续参加城市联盟。约1500年起，当地酿酒者将名为「加莱」的浓烈草本饮品出口到远方市场。出口税帮助修建了市政厅和萨尔茨韦德尔门等建筑。十八世纪初酿酒业衰落，1725年加尔德莱根成为驻军城镇。

english: Gardez lies in a high basin watered by the Gardez River, at the junction of routes connecting Ghazni, Kabul and the valleys leading toward India. Hills rising from the basin offer natural defensive positions, and the Bala Hissar fortress overlooks the old town. For more than a century Gardez was the centre of a small Kharijite principality before its incorporation into the Ghaznavid realm. In the sixteenth century it was a Mughal administrative seat, noted by Babur for its multistorey houses.
simp_chinese: 加德兹位于加德兹河灌溉的高原盆地，地处连接加兹尼、喀布尔与通往印度河谷的道路交会处。盆地中隆起的山丘提供天然防御地势，巴拉希萨尔堡垒俯瞰着老城。加德兹曾是一处哈瓦利吉派小公国的中心，延续百余年后被纳入伽色尼王国。十六世纪它是莫卧儿行政驻地，巴布尔曾注意到城中多层房屋。

english:
Gardman was a historic district and principality in the eastern Caucasian mountains, with a fortress that bore the same name. In the seventh century the Mihranid family displaced the earlier local princely ruling house and came to rule much of Caucasian Albania. The mountainous part of Gardman was also known as Parisos, after a local kingdom.

In the medieval period the fortress remained a seat of regional lords. Much of Gardman came under the Vahramian principality, while another part was held by Ivane. When the Mongols invaded in the thirteenth century, the lord Vahram abandoned the fortress under cover of night. Its position in the mountain country made Gardman a stronghold between the uplands and the lowland plains of Arran.
simp_chinese:
加尔德曼是高加索东部山区的历史地区与公国，拥有一座同名堡垒。七世纪，米赫兰家族取代当地早先的统治家族，后来统治了高加索阿尔巴尼亚的大部分地区。加尔德曼的山区部分也因当地王国而称为帕里索斯。

中世纪时，堡垒仍是地方领主的驻地。加尔德曼大部归入瓦赫拉米安公国，另一部分则由伊瓦内持有。十三世纪蒙古人入侵时，领主瓦赫拉姆趁夜离开了堡垒。加尔德曼位于山区，使它成为高地与阿兰平原之间的一处据点。

english: Garðar stood at the head of Einarsfjord in Greenland's Norse Eastern Settlement. Its cathedral of Saint Nicholas and the bishop's residence rose beside a substantial farm, whose barns could shelter large herds. In the twelfth century Bishop Arnald established his seat here, making Garðar the religious center of the Greenlanders. The estate controlled land and resources around the fjord and beyond. In 1409 two priests at Garðar certified a marriage celebrated the previous year at Hvalsey church. Their letter is among the last written signs of the medieval Norse community in Greenland. After that community disappeared, the fjord country was used by Inuit; in 1783 Anders Olsen and his family settled at Igaliku and resumed farming among the old ruins.
simp_chinese: 加尔扎尔位于格陵兰北欧东部聚落的埃纳尔斯峡湾内端。圣尼古拉主教座堂和主教居所矗立在一座大农场旁，畜棚能够容纳大批牛群。十二世纪，阿尔纳尔德主教在此建立驻地，使加尔扎尔成为格陵兰人的宗教中心。庄园控制着峡湾及更远地区的土地与资源。1409年，加尔扎尔的两位神父证明了前一年在华尔塞教堂举行的一场婚礼。他们的文书是中世纪格陵兰北欧社群留下的最后文字记录之一。社群消失后，因纽特人利用了峡湾地区；1783年，安德斯·奥尔森及家人在伊加利库定居，在古老遗址间重新开展农牧。

english: Gareloi, or Anangusix̂, is a volcanic island in the Delarof group of the western Aleutians. Its steep cone rises directly from the North Pacific, with two summits above the waves. The island belongs to the long chain that was home to the Unangan, whose skin-covered boats carried hunters across the passages between islands. The seas supplied fish and marine mammals, while the treeless shores offered nesting places for seabirds.
simp_chinese: 加雷洛伊又称阿南古西赫，是阿留申群岛西部德拉罗夫岛群中的一座火山岛。陡峭的火山锥从北太平洋海面拔起，两座山峰耸立在波涛之上。这座岛属于乌南甘人世代生活的漫长岛链，猎人乘皮舟穿越岛屿间的水道。海洋提供鱼类和海兽，无树的岛岸则是海鸟筑巢的地方。

english: Garengaze lies in the country between the upper Lualaba and the Luapula, among the woodlands and river valleys of Katanga. This is Sanga country, where local chiefs ruled communities south of the Luba heartland. During the eighteenth century the eastern Lunda kingdom of Kazembe grew around the lower Luapula, extending its influence into the lands east of the Lualaba.
simp_chinese: 加伦加泽位于卢阿拉巴河上游与卢阿普拉河之间，处在加丹加的林地和河谷之中。这是桑加人的土地，地方首领在卢巴腹地以南统治各自社群。十八世纪，东隆达的卡曾贝王国在卢阿普拉河下游兴起，其影响延伸到卢阿拉巴河以东的地区。

english: Gargando lies in the dry country west of Timbuktu, on the northern side of the inland Niger region. Its communities include groups associated with the Kel Ansar, a Tuareg confederation. The surrounding Sahel lies between the Niger's waters and the Sahara, with grazing lands and seasonal routes across the desert margin.
simp_chinese: 加尔甘多位于廷巴克图以西的干燥地区，处于尼日尔河内陆区域北侧。当地社群包括与图阿雷格联盟凯勒安萨尔有关的群体。周围的萨赫勒位于尼日尔河水域与撒哈拉之间，牧地和季节性道路穿过沙漠边缘。

english:
Garha was an early seat of the Gond rulers of Garha-Mandla, near the upper Narmada valley. Its kings built a state whose strongholds and districts extended across much of the surrounding country. Sangram Shah, remembered for possessing fifty-two forts, left his mark near Garha in the great tank called Sangram Sagar and the Bajnamath temple on its bank. The kingdom became one of the most prominent Gond powers of central India.

After the death of Sangram Shah’s son Dalpat Shah, his widow Durgavati governed for their young son. In 1564 the Mughal commander Asaf Khan invaded; Durgavati met his forces and, wounded in battle, chose death rather than capture. The kingdom was subsequently restored under Gond rulers in a reduced form. Its political centre later moved to more defensible sites, including Ramnagar on the Narmada, but Garha remained associated with the dynasty’s rise.
simp_chinese:
加尔哈是加尔哈—门德拉贡德国王早期的驻地，靠近讷尔默达河上游河谷。这里的国王建立了一个国家，其堡垒与辖区遍及周边广大地区。相传拥有五十二座堡垒的桑格拉姆沙阿在加尔哈附近留下大水池桑格拉姆萨加尔及池畔的巴杰纳马特神庙。这个王国成为印度中部最重要的贡德势力之一。

桑格拉姆沙阿之子达尔帕特沙阿去世后，遗孀杜尔伽瓦蒂为幼子摄政。1564年莫卧儿将领阿萨夫汗入侵；杜尔伽瓦蒂迎战受伤，宁死不愿被俘。此后贡德统治者得以恢复规模缩小的王国。政治中心后来迁往更易防守的地方，包括讷尔默达河畔的拉姆那迦，但加尔哈仍与王朝的兴起紧密相连。

sources.title: The Imperial Gazetteer of India Mahbubabad-To-Moradabad-Vol-17.pdf

english: The Garhjat hills of northern Odisha rise between the Baitarani and Brahmani river basins. Wooded ridges and dissected uplands surround the valleys, forming part of the eastern edge of the Indian plateau. The name recalls the many garhs, or fortified seats, from which local chiefs governed their territories. Keonjhar and neighbouring hill states developed in this landscape, distinct from the broad alluvial plains farther east.
simp_chinese: 奥里萨北部的加尔杰特丘陵耸立在拜塔拉尼河和婆罗门尼河流域之间。林木覆盖的山脊与被河流切割的高地环绕山谷，构成印度高原东缘的一部分。地名使人想起众多称为加尔的设防驻地，地方首领从那里统治各自领土。肯杜贾尔及邻近山地邦国在这一景观中发展，与更东面广阔的冲积平原有所不同。

english: Garhwa lies in the upland country south of the Son River, at the western edge of the Palamu region. Rivers including the Kanhar and Danro cross the surrounding landscape, which meets the forested hills of Surguja to the south and west. The Son forms a broad northern boundary, separating these uplands from the plains beyond. The town belongs to a region of river valleys and hills between the Ganges plain and central India.
simp_chinese: 格尔瓦位于松河南方的高地，处在帕拉穆地区西缘。坎哈尔河与丹罗河等河流穿过周围地区，南面和西面的地势与苏尔古贾森林丘陵相接。松河构成宽阔的北方界线，将高地与河对岸的平原分开。此镇所在地区河谷和丘陵交错，介于恒河平原与印度中部之间。

english:
Gari's Russian settlement grew from the search for arable land to supply Pelym. Marshes and a severe climate limited grain production around that northern fortress, encouraging officials to investigate more promising ground. In September 1622 the Pelym governor Pyotr Nikitin sent the clerk Putila Stepanov and companions to inspect the Gari tract, assess its soil and determine how many peasants could be settled on crown ploughland.

Ten peasants were placed in the new settlement in 1623. The following year an order from Tobolsk called for twenty more, showing the importance attached to expanding cultivation. The settlement occupied the right bank of the Sosva and became known as Garinskaya sloboda. Its beginnings therefore belonged to a practical attempt to support the Russian administrative frontier with grain. Survey, peasant resettlement and crown agriculture connected this wooded river country with Pelym, while the small recorded population indicates the limited scale on which the undertaking began.
simp_chinese:
加里的俄人定居，源于为佩雷姆寻找耕地与粮食供应。北方堡城周围沼泽、严寒限制谷物生产，官员因而勘察较适宜的土地。1622年九月，佩雷姆总督彼得·尼基京派书记普季拉·斯捷潘诺夫等赴加里，检查土壤，并估算王室耕地能够安置多少农民。

1623年，新聚落安置十名农民；翌年托博尔斯克又下令增迁二十人，显示当局对扩大耕作的重视。聚落位于索西瓦河右岸，称作加林斯卡亚移民村。因此，当地早期定居属于以粮食支撑俄国行政边地的尝试。勘察、农民迁入与王室农业，将林木河谷连接到佩雷姆；所记人口也显示事业最初规模甚小。

english:
Garibams is a Khoekhoen name for the mouth of the river now called the Orange. The name means river mouth, identifying this Atlantic river crossing rather than an inland town. The indigenous place name preserves a different layer of geographical knowledge from the European names subsequently applied to the river and its mouth.

In 1779 Robert Jacob Gordon travelled north from the Cape through Namaqualand and reached the Orange River mouth. His fourth journey continued inland along the river, with excursions to its northern side, before returning through Namaqualand. Gordon's surviving journals, maps and drawings document this late eighteenth-century encounter with the lower river. The estuary therefore belongs both to a landscape named in Khoekhoen and to the expanding geographical investigations undertaken from the Cape.
simp_chinese:
加里巴姆斯是科伊科伊人对今奥兰治河河口的称呼，意为“河口”，所指为河流入大西洋处，并非内陆城镇。这一原住民地名保存着当地认识地理的一层历史，早于后来应用于河流及其出口的欧洲名称。

1779年，罗伯特·雅各布·戈登从开普地区向北穿越纳马夸兰，抵达奥兰治河口。他的第四次旅行随后沿河深入内陆，并前往河北侧考察，最后经纳马夸兰返回。遗存的日记、地图与绘画记录了十八世纪末对下游河段的考察。河口因而同时保留着科伊科伊地名传统，以及从开普地区逐步展开的地理调查的痕迹。

english:
Gariep was the Khoekhoe name for the great river later called the Orange. In the country around its upper-middle course, river crossings and grazing drew together San hunters, Khoekhoe pastoralists, Xhosa groups and people moving beyond the Cape's settled districts. The river could mark a limit to colonial authority while remaining a route through a connected Indigenous interior.

By the late eighteenth century, frontier leaders such as the Xhosa chief Nzwane, known as Danster, were building followings among these mixed communities. Horses, firearms and trade strengthened mobile groups whose dealings combined negotiation, raiding and exchange. Refugees, escaped servants and people resisting colonial demands also sought room to live along the Gariep. The expansion of Cape authority increasingly narrowed that freedom. In 1824 the colony's northeastern boundary reached the river; in 1830 Colesberg was established south of it on the site of an abandoned London Missionary Society station. The new town became a base for hunters, travellers and settlers heading farther inland. River country that had long sustained African communities now stood at the edge of a rapidly expanding colonial frontier.
simp_chinese:
加里普是科伊科伊人对后来称为奥兰治河的大河的称呼。在中上游一带，渡口与草场吸引桑人猎民、科伊科伊牧民、科萨人，以及离开开普定居区的人群往来。河流可以成为殖民权力的边界，也仍是原住民腹地内部相互联系的通道。

十八世纪末，被称为丹斯特的科萨首领恩兹瓦内等人在这些混合社群中聚集追随者。马匹、火器和贸易增强了流动人群的力量，交涉、劫掠与交换相互交织。难民、逃离劳役者和抵抗殖民要求的人们，也在加里普沿岸寻找立足之地。开普当局的扩张逐渐压缩了这一空间。1824年，殖民地东北边界推进到河流；1830年，南岸一处废弃的伦敦传道会站址上建立科尔斯堡，成为猎人、旅客和定居者进一步进入内陆的据点。这片长期养育非洲社群的河流乡土，由此处在迅速推进的殖民边疆上。

english: Garingbal, also written Garaynbal, is an Aboriginal people and language of central Queensland. Garaynbal has historically been grouped with Biri, but linguistic research identifies significant differences between the varieties. Its speakers belong to the inland country of central Queensland, among neighbouring Aboriginal communities with distinct languages.
simp_chinese: 加林巴尔亦写作加赖恩巴尔，是昆士兰中部的原住民族群和语言名称。加赖恩巴尔语曾被归入比里语，但语言研究发现两者存在显著差异。其使用者属于昆士兰中部内陆地区，与各有语言的原住民社群为邻。

english:
Garmisch lies in an Alpine valley beneath the mountains of southern Bavaria. To its east stands Partenkirchen, an old settlement on the road between Venice and Augsburg. From the late thirteenth century the valley belonged to the County of Werdenfels, ruled by the prince-bishops of Freising. Their representative governed from Werdenfels Castle on a crag north of Garmisch.

A decline in overland commerce, difficult farming on the marshy valley floor and recurrent epidemics brought hardship to the inhabitants. Between 1589 and 1596, witch trials claimed sixty-three lives. The accused were held and tried at Werdenfels Castle, which acquired a fearful reputation and was abandoned in the seventeenth century. Much of its stone was later used to build Garmisch's Baroque New Church, completed in 1752. Freising's rule over the county ended in 1803.
simp_chinese:
加米施坐落在巴伐利亚南部群山环抱的阿尔卑斯山谷中。东面的帕滕基兴是一处古老聚落，位于威尼斯通往奥格斯堡的道路上。十三世纪末起，谷地属于弗赖辛采邑主教统治的韦尔登费尔斯伯国；主教的代表从加米施以北山岩上的韦尔登费尔斯堡治理此地。

陆路贸易衰退、沼泽谷底难以耕种，加上反复流行的疫病，给居民带来困苦。一五八九至一五九六年间，猎巫审判夺去了六十三人的生命。被告在韦尔登费尔斯堡关押受审，城堡逐渐令人恐惧，十七世纪被废弃。其大量石料后来用于修建加米施的巴洛克新教堂，教堂于一七五二年完工。一八〇三年，弗赖辛对伯国的统治结束。

english:
Garmsir occupied the warm lower Helmand country south of Kandahar. In the late Timurid period its fortunes were linked to the rulers and commanders of Kandahar, while the river valley connected this country with Sistan. After Shah Rukh's death in 1447, the wider Kandahar region, including Garmsir, suffered repeated assaults; Sultan Husayn Bayqara's commander Dhu'l-Nun Arghun was appointed to Kandahar in 1479 and restored order across the region.

Babur's campaigns brought another change in the early sixteenth century. After defeating the Arghun brothers around Kandahar, he occupied Garmsir along the Helmand, previously part of Shah Beg's dominions. Control of this river country formed one element of the contest over Kandahar, whose rulers depended on surrounding districts and routes as well as the fortified city itself.
simp_chinese:
加姆塞尔位于坎大哈以南、气候温暖的赫尔曼德河下游地区。帖木儿王朝后期，它的命运与坎大哈统治者和将领相连，河谷又将其接向锡斯坦。1447年沙鲁死后，包括加姆塞尔在内的坎大哈地区屡受袭扰；侯赛因·拜卡拉的将领祖勒农·阿尔浑于1479年赴坎大哈任职，恢复了当地秩序。

16世纪初，巴布尔的战事带来新的变化。他在坎大哈附近击败阿尔浑兄弟后，占据了原属沙赫贝格领地、沿赫尔曼德河分布的加姆塞尔。控制这片河谷，是坎大哈争夺中的一环；当地统治者既依赖坚固城池，也依赖周边地区和交通路线。

english: Garoowe lies in the dry Nugaal country of northeastern Somalia, between the Sool plateau and the hills that rise towards the Gulf of Aden. Seasonal watercourses cross the broad valley, while pastoralists move livestock across its grazing lands. The region formed part of the wider country associated with the Majeerteen, whose sultanate linked inland Somali communities with settlements on the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 加罗韦位于索马里东北部干旱的努加尔地区，介于苏勒高原与朝亚丁湾隆起的山丘之间。季节性水道穿过宽阔河谷，牧民则带领牲畜在草场间移动。这一带属于与马杰尔廷人相关的广大地区，其苏丹国把索马里内陆社群与北部海岸聚落联系起来。

english: Garoumalé is associated with the early history of Kanem-Bornu, in the country north of Lake Chad. An enclosure of sun-dried brick surrounds the old site, and within it stood structures built of fired red brick, often called a palace. Historical traditions describe Garoumalé as a seat of the Sayfawa rulers after they left Njimi and before they established Birni Ngazargamu in the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 加鲁马莱位于乍得湖北方的土地上，与加涅姆—博尔努早期历史有所关联。旧址周围有一道晒干土砖砌成的围墙，墙内曾矗立烧制红砖建成的建筑，常被称为宫殿。历史传说将加鲁马莱记作赛法瓦统治者的一处治所，时间是在他们离开恩吉米之后、十五世纪建立比尔尼·恩加扎尔加穆之前。

english:
Garove is the largest of the Vitu Islands, north of New Britain in the Bismarck Sea. These waters attracted an ambitious American trading venture in the 1830s. Benjamin Morrell hoped to exchange iron, beads, mirrors and cutlery for pearl shell, pearls, dried sea cucumbers, gold and sandalwood, and eventually establish a trading colony on Garove.

His plans depended on relationships with neighbouring islanders. In 1830 he had abducted Dako, the son of an important leader on Uneapa, and taken him to America. Dako returned on Morrell's later expedition, which reached the Bismarck Archipelago in November 1834. Through him, Morrell developed trading connections with communities on New Britain, the Siassi Islands and the New Guinea mainland. The proposed Garove colony remained an ambition: Morrell stopped visiting the region after 1835, and his ship was wrecked off Madagascar on its homeward voyage. Garove's waters lay within an existing island trading world that foreign merchants sought to enter and redirect.
simp_chinese:
加罗维是新不列颠以北维图群岛中最大的岛屿，位于俾斯麦海。十九世纪三十年代，一项雄心勃勃的美国贸易计划将目光投向这里。本杰明·莫雷尔打算用铁器、珠子、镜子和餐具换取珍珠贝、珍珠、海参干、黄金与檀香，并最终在加罗维建立贸易殖民据点。

他的计划依赖与邻近岛民的关系。1830年，莫雷尔掳走乌内阿帕岛一位重要首领之子达科，将其带往美国。达科随之后的探险返乡，船队于1834年十一月抵达俾斯麦群岛。借助达科，莫雷尔与新不列颠、西亚西群岛及新几内亚本岛的社区建立贸易联系。加罗维殖民据点始终停留于计划；莫雷尔在1835年以后不再到访，其船归航途中在马达加斯加附近失事。外商试图进入并改变的，是早已存在的岛际贸易世界。

english: Garreh is the country of the Garre, a pastoral clan whose communities range across the dry lands of the northern Kenyan and southern Ethiopian interior. Their herds move in search of pasture and water, and their traditions place them in the Mandera region before the Oromo expansion of the sixteenth century. Kinship ties connect communities across a wide and often arid landscape.
simp_chinese: 加雷是加雷人的土地。这个牧民氏族的社群分布在肯尼亚北部和埃塞俄比亚南部内陆的干燥地带，逐水草放牧。按照他们的传统，早在十六世纪奥罗莫人扩张以前，他们便已居住在曼德拉地区。亲缘关系将广阔干旱地带中的社群联系起来。

english:
Gartok stands on the upper Indus in western Tibet, along the long route between Leh and Shigatse. Its market brought together traders carrying wool and other goods across the high plateau and Himalayan passes. The settlement also served as an administrative centre for Ngari, a region whose routes connected Ladakh with the Tibetan interior.

After war between Ladakh and the Lhasa government, the Treaty of Tingmosgang in 1684 regulated their border and trade. It reserved the Ngari wool trade to Ladakhi merchants and provided for a periodic Ladakhi mission to Lhasa. Under the resulting arrangements, Gartok became a principal market for western Tibetan wool, including the fine pashmina prized by weavers farther west. Its role as an administrative headquarters followed the extension of Lhasa's authority over western Tibet.
simp_chinese:
噶大克位于西藏西部印度河上游，坐落在连接列城与日喀则的漫长道路上。商人穿过高原和喜马拉雅山口，在此交换羊毛等货物。它也是阿里地区的行政中心，其道路将拉达克与藏地腹地相连。

拉达克与拉萨政府交战后，双方于1684年签订廷莫斯冈条约，规定边界与贸易。条约将阿里羊毛贸易留给拉达克商人，并规定拉达克定期向拉萨派遣使团。在此安排下，噶大克成为西藏西部羊毛的重要市场，其中包括深受更西方织工珍视的细软帕什米纳羊绒。拉萨权力伸入西藏西部后，噶大克也成为当地行政驻地。

english:
Garu occupies a high mountainside above Choras in the upper Marañón country. Built before Inca rule, this extensive settlement is associated with the Yarowilca people. Its stone buildings, streets and funerary towers cover the slope of Cóndor Waganan, about 3,700 metres above sea level. The density and arrangement of its structures make Garu one of the most striking settlements of the region.

Garu's architecture shares features with other sites in the upper Marañón and the Tantamayo valley, where communities built substantial settlements in the highlands. Inca buildings also stand among its remains, reflecting the later incorporation of the region into the empire. The contrast between local buildings and imperial constructions preserves evidence of changing authority in a landscape long occupied before the Inca arrived.
simp_chinese:
加鲁位于马拉尼翁河上游地区，坐落在乔拉斯上方的高山坡地。这处规模广大的聚落建于印加统治之前，与亚罗维尔卡人有关。石建筑、街道和墓塔覆盖孔多尔瓦加南山坡，海拔约3700米。建筑密集而有序，使加鲁成为这一地区最醒目的聚落之一。

加鲁的建筑与马拉尼翁河上游及坦塔马约谷地的其他遗址具有相似特征，这些高地社群都修建了规模可观的聚落。遗址中也有印加建筑，反映当地后来被纳入帝国。地方建筑与帝国建筑之间的差异，保存了印加人到来之前便已长期有人居住的地区权力变化的痕迹。

english: Garun Gabas was one of several kingdoms in the country around Hadejia, west of the Bornu heartland. Local tradition counts it and Auyo among the oldest of these states. Their rulers are remembered as receiving their titles from the mai of Bornu through the Galadima, whose seat was at Nguru. The Galadima governed Bornu's western marches, placing these small kingdoms within a network of regional authority.
simp_chinese: 加伦加巴斯是博尔努腹地以西、哈代贾一带的几个王国之一。当地传说将它和奥约列为其中最古老的国家。人们记得，这些王国的统治者通过驻守恩古鲁的加拉迪马，从博尔努的迈那里获得称号。加拉迪马负责治理博尔努西部边疆，这些小王国也因而处在相互关联的地区权力网络之中。

english: Garwolin stands on the Wilga in eastern Mazovia. Its name appears in medieval records in 1386 and 1404, and the settlement had town rights by 1423. From 1539 it was a county seat in Czersk Land and a busy centre of crafts and trade. An inventory of 1565 counted 230 craftsmen, including shoemakers, smiths and many brewers; Garwolin was known for its beer. The Swedish invasion devastated the town, leaving only fifty houses and a greatly reduced population.
simp_chinese: 加尔沃林位于马佐夫舍东部的维尔加河畔，名字见于1386和1404年的中世纪记载，1423年以前已获得城市权利。1539年起，它成为切尔斯克地区的县治，也是活跃的手工业和贸易中心。1565年的清册记载了230名工匠，其中有鞋匠、铁匠和众多酿酒师；加尔沃林以啤酒闻名。瑞典入侵使城镇遭到重创，只剩五十座房屋，人口也急剧减少。

english: The Gashowu were a Foothill Yokuts people whose country included Auberry Valley and the creeks flowing towards the San Joaquin Valley. Their villages included Yokau on Little Dry Creek and Pohoniu on Big Dry Creek. Along the San Joaquin River, the area known as Shish Liu was another part of a homeland shared with neighboring Yokuts communities. Gashowu was a variety of the Yokuts language, spoken among the peoples of the valley and the Sierra Nevada foothills.
simp_chinese: 加绍乌人是山麓约库茨人的一支，其土地包括欧伯里谷地和流向圣华金谷地的溪流。村庄中有小德赖溪畔的约考，以及大德赖溪畔的波霍纽。圣华金河边名为希什柳的地区，也是他们与邻近约库茨社群共同生活的故土之一。加绍乌语是约库茨语的一种方言，为谷地和内华达山脉山麓的居民所使用。

english: Yiliping is a dry salt lake in northwestern Qaidam, amid a landscape shaped by persistent winds. Between Lenghu and Dachaidan, wind has carved the basin's sediments into long yardang ridges, while salty depressions collect the waters that reach the floor of this enclosed desert basin.
simp_chinese: 一里坪是柴达木西北部的干盐湖，周围地貌深受风力塑造。冷湖与大柴旦之间，风将盆地沉积物雕成一道道雅丹垄脊；洼地则汇集流到这座封闭荒漠盆地底部的咸水。

english: The Gaspar Strait separates Bangka and Belitung, two islands off the eastern coast of Sumatra. Its waters form a passage through the island-studded seas between Sumatra and Borneo. The strait takes its European name from a Spanish captain who passed through it in 1724, although the islands and their channels were known to local seafarers long before his voyage.
simp_chinese: 加斯帕海峡分隔苏门答腊东岸外的邦加岛与勿里洞岛，是穿越苏门答腊和婆罗洲之间岛屿密布海域的一条通道。海峡的欧洲名称来自一位于1724年经过这里的西班牙船长；在他的航行以前，当地水手早已熟悉这些岛屿与水道。

english:
Gaspé lies at the eastern end of the peninsula reaching into the Gulf of St Lawrence. Its sheltered bay and surrounding waters formed part of a wider Indigenous landscape in which the Mi'kmaq travelled and fished seasonally.

In 1534 Jacques Cartier anchored in Gaspé Bay, where he met people from Stadacona who had come to fish, and erected a cross in the name of the French king. From the sixteenth century European fishers visited the peninsula for its cod and sheltered shores. Over time, fishing stations linked Gaspé to Atlantic trade, while Indigenous communities continued to use the region's land and waters.
simp_chinese:
加斯佩位于伸入圣劳伦斯湾的半岛东端。受海岸遮蔽的海湾和周围水域属于更广阔的原住民活动范围，米克马克人在这一带季节性地往来和捕鱼。

1534年，雅克·卡蒂埃在加斯佩湾抛锚，遇到从斯塔达科纳前来捕鱼的人们，并以法国国王的名义竖立十字架。16世纪起，欧洲渔民为了鳕鱼和可供停泊的海岸来到半岛。随着时间推移，渔业据点将加斯佩接入大西洋贸易，而原住民社群仍继续利用当地的陆地与水域。

english:
Gaspé Bay cuts into the eastern end of the Gaspé Peninsula, receiving the waters of the Dartmouth and York rivers. Its sheltered harbour drew fishing parties from the St. Lawrence as well as ships from across the Atlantic. In July 1534 Jacques Cartier and his two ships sought shelter from a storm here while Donnacona and his people from Stadacona were fishing for mackerel.

Cartier raised a wooden cross bearing the arms of King Francis I, an act that offended Donnacona, who challenged the French. The chief's canoe was seized and he was brought aboard their ship; when Cartier sailed for France, he took Donnacona's sons Taignoagny and Domagaya with him. They returned as guides on his next voyage up the St. Lawrence.
simp_chinese:
加斯佩湾深入加斯佩半岛东端，达特茅斯河与约克河汇入其中。避风港湾吸引圣劳伦斯河沿岸的捕鱼人，也吸引大西洋彼岸的船只。1534年7月，雅克·卡蒂埃率两艘船在此躲避风暴，当时多纳科纳和来自斯塔达科纳的族人正在湾内捕捞鲭鱼。

卡蒂埃竖起一座饰有法王弗朗索瓦一世纹章的木十字架，多纳科纳对此感到受辱，向法国人提出抗议。他的独木舟被扣住，自己也被带上法船；卡蒂埃启航返回法国时，带走了多纳科纳的两个儿子泰尼亚尼和多马加亚。两人在他下次沿圣劳伦斯河上行时作为向导返回。

english: The Gatineau Hills form the northern shoulder of the Ottawa Valley, where the southern tip of the Canadian Shield rises into rounded, worn heights. Maple, beech and oak cover the slopes, with stands of white pine among them. Algonquin people had lived in the Ottawa valley for more than four thousand years when French explorers arrived in the early seventeenth century. In the early 1800s the pine forests were logged extensively, and roads were built into the hills for mining and farming.
simp_chinese: 加蒂诺山构成渥太华河谷北侧的肩部，位于加拿大地盾南端，浑圆而饱经风化的高地是这一地块的特征。山坡上生长着枫树、山毛榉和橡树，间杂成片的白松。阿尔冈昆人在渥太华河谷生活已逾四千年，17世纪初法国探险者来到这里。19世纪初，山中的松林被大规模砍伐，并修筑了供采矿和农耕使用的道路。

english: Gattaran lies along the Cagayan River in northern Luzon, between the inland valley and the river's mouth. Dominican missionaries established a mission here in 1623. Its church of Saint Catherine was later built in red brick and completed in 1739. Nearby Nassiping, an older mission near the meeting of the Chico and Cagayan rivers, also had a stone church. These river settlements formed part of the network through which missionaries and colonial officials worked in the valley.
simp_chinese: 加塔兰位于吕宋北部的卡加延河沿岸，介于内陆河谷与河口之间。多明我会传教士于1623年在此建立传教站，后来的圣加大肋纳教堂以红砖建成，于1739年竣工。附近纳西平靠近奇科河与卡加延河交汇处，是更早建立的传教站，也有一座石教堂。这些河畔聚落构成传教士和殖民官员在河谷活动的网络。

english: Gaua is a volcanic island in the Banks group of northern Vanuatu. Its mountains enclose Lake Letas, a large crater lake, with the volcanic cone of Mount Garet rising nearby. In 1606 the expedition of Pedro Fernández de Quirós reached the northern islands and called Gaua Santa María. Island communities already occupied the shores and the forested land around the volcano.
simp_chinese: 高阿是瓦努阿图北部班克斯群岛的一座火山岛。群山环绕大型火山口湖莱塔斯湖，附近升起加雷特火山锥。1606年，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的远征队抵达北部诸岛，将高阿称为圣玛丽亚。此前岛上社群早已居住在海岸及火山周围的森林地区。

english:
Gaur, also called Lakhnauti, was the greatest city of medieval Bengal, spread along the Ganges and the Mahananda with a citadel, canals, tanks and brick mosques faced with glazed tile. Boats crowded the river landings below its walls, and weavers, goldsmiths and merchants filled its quarters. For centuries it stood for Bengal itself.

When the sultanate of Bengal formed, the seat of power moved. In 1342 Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah overthrew the governor at Lakhnauti and by 1352 had united Bengal under his rule, with Pandua as his capital. In 1450 Sultan Mahmud Shah announced the return to Gaur, which was complete by 1453. Under Ruknuddin Barbak Shah the Dakhil Darwaza, a ceremonial gate of the citadel, was raised in 1465, and the Firuz Minar and the Tantipara Mosque followed in the later fifteenth century.

Gaur reached its height under the Husain Shahi sultans. Estimates of its population range from forty thousand in 1515 to two hundred thousand, and Portuguese visitors compared its wealth with Lisbon's. Alauddin Husain Shah's ministers Rupa and Sanatana were drawn to the teaching of Chaitanya, who passed through nearby Ramkeli in 1514. Nusrat Shah completed the Bara Sona Mosque and the Qadam Rasul in the 1520s and 1530. In 1538 Humayun entered the city after Sher Shah's departure and renamed it Jannatabad, but sickness and Sher Shah's return drove him out. The Karrani rulers moved the capital to Tanda in 1565. Munim Khan restored Gaur in 1575, and then an epidemic killed him and his army. The river drifted away from the walls, and the capital was abandoned.
simp_chinese:
高达又名洛克瑙提，是中世纪孟加拉最伟大的城市，沿恒河与马哈南达河展开，有城堡、水渠、池塘，以及贴着釉面砖的砖砌清真寺。船只挤满城墙下的河埠，织工、金匠和商人充斥着各个街区。数百年间，它几乎就是孟加拉的代名词。

孟加拉素丹国形成后，权力中心也随之移动。1342年，沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙阿推翻洛克瑙提的总督，到1352年已统一孟加拉，并以潘杜阿为都。1450年，素丹马哈茂德·沙阿宣布迁回高达，1453年完成。在鲁肯丁·巴尔巴克·沙阿治下，作为城堡礼仪大门的达希尔门于1465年建成，菲鲁兹塔和坦蒂帕拉清真寺则在15世纪后期相继出现。

高达在侯赛因沙希王朝诸素丹治下达到顶峰。它的人口估计从1515年的四万人到二十万人不等，葡萄牙访客把它的富庶比作里斯本。阿拉丁·侯赛因·沙阿的大臣鲁帕和萨纳塔纳被柴坦尼亚的教导吸引，后者于1514年途经附近的拉姆凯利。努斯拉特·沙阿在16世纪20年代建成大金清真寺，并于1530年建成圣足堂。1538年，胡马雍在谢尔沙离开后进入此城，将它改名詹纳塔巴德，却因疾病和谢尔沙的返回而被迫撤走。卡拉尼王朝于1565年把都城迁到坦达。1575年蒙伊姆汗重新启用高达，随后一场瘟疫夺去了他和军队的性命。河流渐渐远离城墙，都城就此废弃。

english: Gävlebukten is the broad bay of the Bothnian Sea off Gävle, between the Swedish coast and the Finngrunden banks. The Dalälven reaches the sea near Skutskär, adding its fresh water to the bay. Its coastal approaches linked Gävle with the waters farther north; in 1721 Russian galleys raided the Norrland coast from this region towards Piteå.
simp_chinese: 耶夫勒湾是耶夫勒外海波的尼亚海中的宽阔海湾，位于瑞典海岸与芬恩格伦登浅滩之间。达拉河在斯库特谢尔附近注入海湾，为海水带来淡水。沿岸水路将耶夫勒与更北方的水域相连；1721年俄国桨帆舰队从这一带向皮特奥方向袭击诺尔兰海岸。

english: Gavrilovskoye lies west of Suzdal in the old Vladimir-Suzdal countryside. Mentioned in a charter of Ivan the Terrible in 1551, it belonged from the middle of the sixteenth century to Suzdal's Convent of the Intercession. Parishioners built a stone church dedicated to the Conception of John the Baptist in 1799, followed by a warm church of the Epiphany in 1823. The village thus remained tied to the monasteries and parish churches that shaped the religious life of the Suzdal district.
simp_chinese: 加夫里洛夫斯科耶位于苏兹达尔以西的弗拉基米尔—苏兹达尔乡间。1551年伊凡雷帝的一份文书提到此地；自十六世纪中叶起，它属于苏兹达尔的圣母帡幪女修道院。1799年，教区居民出资兴建了一座奉献给施洗约翰受孕节的石教堂，1823年又建起一座供冬季使用的主显节教堂。这座村庄与塑造苏兹达尔地区宗教生活的修道院和教区教堂始终紧密相连。

english: Gawakomitigweia is an Ojibwe name translated as Clearwater, applied to a river of northwestern Minnesota. The Clearwater River flows from lake country westward to the Red Lake River, carrying water from the forested uplands toward the prairie. Its clear water contrasts with the sediment-laden rivers farther west. Lakes and marshes along its course lie within a landscape long travelled and used by Ojibwe communities.
simp_chinese: 加瓦科米蒂格维亚是译作“清水”的奥吉布瓦语名称，用于明尼苏达西北部的一条河流。清水河从湖泊地带向西流入红湖河，把林木高地的水带往草原。清澈河水与更西方携带泥沙的河流形成对比。沿岸湖泊与沼泽属于奥吉布瓦社群长期旅行和利用的地带。

sources.title: List of Minnesota placenames of Native American origin

english:
Gawilgarh is a mountain fortress in the Satpura country north of the Deccan. Its name recalls the Gawli cattle herders of Berar. The date of its first construction is unknown, but the historian Firishta records that the Bahmani king Ahmad Shah Wali rebuilt it in 1425 while encamped at Ellichpur.

In 1803 Arthur Wellesley besieged the Maratha stronghold during the Second Anglo-Maratha War. After attacks on the main gate failed, Captain Campbell led Highlanders up the ravine between the outer and inner forts and over the inner defences. They forced the northern gatehouse and opened the way for the rest of the troops. The fort was returned to its Maratha commander, Rana Shivsingh Rajput, after peace was made, but was subsequently abandoned.
simp_chinese:
加维尔加尔是一座山地堡垒，坐落在德干以北的萨特普拉山区，名字使人想起贝拉尔地区的高利牧牛人。最初营建的年代已不可考，但史家菲里什塔记载，巴赫曼尼国王艾哈迈德沙·瓦利于1425年驻营埃利奇普尔期间重建了此堡。

1803年第二次英马战争期间，阿瑟·韦尔斯利围攻这座马拉塔要塞。正门进攻失败后，坎贝尔上尉率高地兵沿内外堡之间的沟谷攀登，越过内堡防线。他们攻破北部门楼，为其余部队打开道路。议和后，堡垒交还马拉塔守将拉纳·希夫辛格·拉杰普特，随后被放弃。

english: Gaxun Gobi lies in the arid country around the Gaxun Nur basin, south of the Mongolian frontier. The lake bed and its fine sediments occupy a landscape of gravel, dust and desert plains. Ancient shorelines preserve evidence that water once stood at different levels in this closed basin. Wind can lift the exposed sediments into dust storms that travel far across the Gobi.
simp_chinese: 嘎顺戈壁位于蒙古边地以南、嘎顺淖尔盆地周围的旱地。湖床与细颗粒沉积处在砾石、尘土和荒漠平原组成的景观中。古代湖岸线记录了封闭盆地里的水位曾经发生变化；风能将裸露沉积物卷成尘暴，带往戈壁远方。

english:
Gaya is one of the sacred cities of the Hindu world, standing beside the Phalgu River in the old country of Magadha. Pilgrims come to make offerings for their ancestors, especially the rite of pinda dana. The Vishnupad temple marks a footprint revered as that of Vishnu, while the riverbank and surrounding sacred places form part of the pilgrimage landscape. South of Gaya lies Bodh Gaya, where Buddhist tradition places the enlightenment of the Buddha beneath the Bodhi tree. Its Mahabodhi temple became a destination for devotees from across Asia.

The fortunes of these neighbouring sacred centres changed over the centuries. The Mahabodhi temple suffered neglect after the decline of Buddhism in the region, but pilgrims continued to visit: Tibetan travellers recorded their journeys there in the eighteenth century. At Gaya itself, the Vishnupad temple was rebuilt in the late eighteenth century under the patronage of Ahilyabai Holkar. The enduring rites for the dead and the memory of the Buddha’s awakening made the district a meeting place for distinct religious traditions long after the ancient kingdoms of Magadha had passed.
simp_chinese:
迦耶坐落在古摩揭陀地区的法尔古河畔，是印度教的重要圣城。朝圣者来到这里为祖先献祭，尤其举行供奉饭团的祖先祭礼。毗湿奴足迹寺供奉着被视为毗湿奴足印的圣迹，河岸和周围圣地共同构成朝圣的空间。迦耶以南是菩提伽耶；佛教传统认为佛陀在那里的菩提树下觉悟，摩诃菩提寺因而吸引了来自亚洲各地的信众。

相邻圣地的命运随时代变化。当地佛教衰落后，摩诃菩提寺一度受到冷落，但朝圣并未中断：十八世纪仍有西藏旅行者留下到访记录。迦耶的毗湿奴足迹寺则在十八世纪末由阿希利娅拜·霍尔卡资助重建。对祖先的持续祭祀和佛陀觉悟的记忆，使这一地区在摩揭陀古代诸王国消逝后，仍是不同宗教传统交会的地方。

english: Gaya lies east of Kano in the Hausa country. Traditions of Kano's beginnings tell of an ironworker named Kano who came from Gaya in search of ironstone and settled near Dala Hill. The story connects the city to older communities of smiths and the working of iron in the surrounding region.
simp_chinese: 加亚位于豪萨地区的卡诺以东。关于卡诺城起源的传说讲述，一位名叫卡诺的铁匠从加亚前来寻找铁矿石，在达拉山附近定居。这一故事将城市的起源与周边更早的铁匠社群和冶铁活动联系起来。

english: The Nicholson River crosses the plains south of the Gulf of Carpentaria, joined by the Gregory before it reaches the coast. In the wet season, its lower country can flood over broad areas. Ganggalida country extends inland towards the Nicholson; farther downstream, the river's delta includes freshwater swamps, claypans and tidal channels shared with the Gregory and Albert rivers.
simp_chinese: 尼科尔森河流过卡奔塔利亚湾以南的平原，与格雷戈里河汇合后流向海岸。雨季时，下游大片土地可能被洪水淹没。冈加利达人地域向内陆延伸至尼科尔森河一带；再往下游，河流三角洲包含淡水沼泽、黏土洼地和潮汐水道，与格雷戈里河、阿尔伯特河的湿地相连。

english: Gayiri is an Aboriginal language and people of central Queensland. It is associated with the inland country of the region, where rivers cross plains and wooded ground. Gayiri is among the names linked to the Gungabula language group, within a wider network of neighbouring Aboriginal languages.
simp_chinese: 盖伊里是昆士兰中部的原住民语言和人群名称。它与当地内陆地区有关，河流穿过平原与林地。盖伊里是与贡加布拉语群相关的名称之一，属于更广泛的相邻原住民语言网络。

english:
Gayny stands on the right bank of the upper Kama, in the forest country north of Kudymkar. Its Komi-Permyak name is Gajna. The settlement appears as a pogost, a rural parish centre, in the first census of Great Perm in 1579. This is a date of documentary attestation, rather than proof that the community was founded in that year. The river placed it within the northern Kama country, well away from the great urban centres of Muscovy.

The surrounding district was associated with Komi-Permyak communities and a dense network of rivers. Forests, water and a short growing season shaped the physical setting of settlement, while the pogost provided a fixed point in this dispersed countryside. By the imperial period Gayny was the centre of Gayny volost in Cherdyn county. Its early history is consequently that of a northern rural centre on the Kama, rather than the much later industrial logging settlement. Written administration and parish organisation became part of an older landscape whose routes followed the river and its tributaries.
simp_chinese:
盖内位于卡马河上游右岸，处在库德姆卡尔以北的森林地区，科米—彼尔米亚克语名为Gajna。1579年大彼尔姆首次人口登记中，这里已作为乡村教区中心pogost出现。这是文献确证其存在的年份，不能据此断定聚落始建于当年。河流把它置于北卡马地区，远离莫斯科国家的大型城市。

周围地域与科米—彼尔米亚克社群相关，河流网络稠密。森林、水域和较短的生长季构成聚落的自然环境，教区中心则为分散乡村提供了相对固定的节点。帝俄时期，盖内是切尔登县盖内乡的中心。因此，其较早历史属于卡马河畔的北方乡村中心，不能被更晚的工业伐木聚落形象取代。书面行政与教区组织逐渐进入这片更古老的土地，河流及其支流继续决定当地交通的基本方向。

english: Gayo Lues lies in the mountainous interior of northern Sumatra, home to Gayo-speaking communities. Here the Saman dance brings a line of seated performers together in rapid, coordinated movement, accompanied by voices and the striking of hands on bodies. The Gayo highlands lie between the coasts of Aceh, beyond the narrow lowlands facing the sea.
simp_chinese: 加约卢斯位于苏门答腊北部的多山内陆，是加约语社群的家园。当地的萨曼舞由一排坐着的舞者共同表演，以迅速整齐的动作配合歌声和拍打身体的节奏。加约高地位于亚齐两侧海岸之间，远在面海的狭窄低地之外。

english: Gayon recalls the Gayones, an Indigenous people who inhabited the mountains and valleys around El Tocuyo in western Venezuela. Their country included the Sanare range and the hills overlooking the Tocuyo River. Spanish settlers established El Tocuyo in 1545, bringing new demands upon the people of the region. In 1640 Gayón families from the Humocaro encomienda were moved to Yaritagua to found a mission settlement.
simp_chinese: 加永的名字使人想起加永人，他们曾居住在委内瑞拉西部埃尔托库约周围的山地与谷地。其土地包括萨纳雷山脉和俯瞰托库约河的丘陵。1545年，西班牙定居者建立埃尔托库约，向当地居民提出新的要求。1640年，来自乌莫卡罗委托监护地的加永家庭被迁往亚里塔瓜，建立一处传教聚落。

english: The mountains of western Venezuela include the country of the Gayón, an Indigenous people whose territory extended through the hills and valleys of Lara and Portuguesa. Before Spanish colonization their communities inhabited the ranges around El Tocuyo and Sanare. Colonial missions later gathered some Gayón people into settlements in the Llanos and foothills. Mountain streams and valleys connect this rugged country to the plains below.
simp_chinese: 委内瑞拉西部山地包括加永人的土地，他们的领地延伸至拉腊与葡萄牙萨的山丘和谷地。西班牙殖民之前，加永社群居住在埃尔托库约和萨纳雷周围山脉。殖民传教活动后来将部分加永人集中到亚诺斯及山麓聚落。山间溪流和谷地将这片崎岖地区与下方平原相连。

english:
Gaza stands near the Mediterranean at the meeting of the roads from Egypt, Arabia and the Levant. Its oasis and markets made it a place of exchange long before the Roman and Islamic periods, while armies crossing between Egypt and Syria repeatedly sought control of the city. Mosques, churches and caravanserais reflected its long history as a commercial and religious centre at the edge of the desert.

After the Ottoman conquest in 1516, Gaza became the seat of a district governed for much of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries by members of the Ridwan family. Their residence, the Pasha's Palace, stood in the city, and their influence extended across southern Palestine. The Ridwan era brought a period of prosperity to Gaza, though its fortunes declined after the family lost its offices. Caravans carrying merchants and pilgrims continued to pass between Egypt and the cities of Syria, keeping the town connected to the wider region.

In 1799 Napoleon's army occupied Gaza during its advance from Egypt into Palestine. The city surrendered, and the French commander stayed at the Pasha's Palace before marching north towards Jaffa and Acre. His unsuccessful siege of Acre forced a retreat through Gaza later that year, once again bringing an army across the ancient road between Asia and Africa.
simp_chinese:
加沙靠近地中海，位于埃及、阿拉伯与黎凡特道路的交汇处。远在罗马和伊斯兰时期之前，绿洲与市场就使这里成为货物交换之地；往来埃及和叙利亚的军队也屡次争夺这座城市。清真寺、教堂和商栈反映了它作为荒漠边缘商业与宗教中心的悠久历史。

一五一六年奥斯曼征服后，加沙成为一个辖区的中心，十六至十七世纪大部分时间由里德万家族成员担任总督。家族在城中建有驻邸帕夏宫，其影响延伸至巴勒斯坦南部。里德万时期加沙一度繁荣，家族失去官职后城市的境况逐渐衰落。载着商人与朝觐者往来埃及和叙利亚各城的商队仍继续经过此地，维持它与更广阔地区的联系。

一七九九年，拿破仑的军队从埃及向巴勒斯坦推进时占领加沙。城市投降，法国统帅在帕夏宫停留，随后向北进军雅法和阿卡。围攻阿卡失败后，他于同年撤退，再次经过加沙；连接亚非的古道又一次迎来了行军队伍。

english:
Gazanjyk belongs to the country between the Kopet Dag foothills and the Karakum, where western Khorasan approached the Caspian and the Turkmen steppe. Travellers crossing this arid landscape depended on wells and guides, while pastoral communities moved herds between seasonal grazing areas.

During the early modern centuries, the wider region lay between Iranian states, Khivan rulers and Turkmen groups whose authority often rested on tribal alliances. Safavid and later Afsharid power reached into Khorasan, while local communities maintained ties across political boundaries through trade, kinship and migration. Horses, livestock, wool and other pastoral products connected the steppe with oasis markets. Caravans carried textiles and grain in the opposite direction, but insecurity and the distance between wells made transport demanding.
simp_chinese:
卡赞吉克属于科佩特山麓与卡拉库姆之间的地区，西呼罗珊在这里接近里海和土库曼草原。旅人穿越干旱地带依靠水井和向导，牧民则在季节性草场之间迁移畜群。

近代早期，更广阔的地区处于伊朗政权、希瓦统治者和土库曼群体之间，地方权力常依靠部落联盟。萨法维及后来的阿夫沙尔政权进入呼罗珊，社群仍通过贸易、亲属关系和迁徙跨越政治边界。马匹、牲畜、羊毛等牧业产品进入绿洲市场，纺织品与粮食则由商队运往草原。水井相距遥远和治安不稳使交通艰难。

english: Ikh Gazriin Chuluu rises from the open country of the eastern Gobi as a mass of weathered granite. Its rocky peaks and narrow valleys stand out against the surrounding plains, offering a distinctive landmark in a landscape of sparse vegetation. The formations belong to the dry interior of the Mongolian plateau, where exposed stone, grassland and desert meet beneath a climate of great seasonal extremes.
simp_chinese: 东戈壁开阔的土地上，伊赫嘎兹林楚鲁的风化花岗岩山体拔地而起。岩峰和狭窄山谷与周围平原形成鲜明对照，是植被稀疏的地带中醒目的地标。这片岩石地貌属于蒙古高原干燥的内陆，裸露岩石、草原与荒漠在此相接，季节间气候差异十分显著。

english: The Gallatin River descends from the Yellowstone high country through a mountain canyon and north across a broad valley. Beyond the ranges it joins the Madison and Jefferson rivers to form the Missouri. The mountains and valleys around these headwaters were used by Shoshone and other Indigenous peoples. By the mid-eighteenth century, the Blackfeet had obtained firearms and drove the Shoshone from much of the upper Missouri country. Lewis and Clark reached the meeting of the three rivers in 1805.
simp_chinese: 加勒廷河从黄石高地流下，穿过山间峡谷，再向北流经宽阔谷地。出山后，它与麦迪逊河、杰斐逊河汇合成密苏里河。源头周围的山谷曾为肖肖尼人及其他原住民族使用。十八世纪中叶，黑脚人获得火器，将肖肖尼人逐出密苏里河上游的大片地区。1805年，刘易斯与克拉克抵达这三条河的汇合处。

english: Gbabiri lies east of Bozoum in the country of the Gbaya. Among Gbaya communities, descent was traced through the father’s line, and families honoured their ancestors in prayers and rites associated with the sharing of game. Hunting, gathering, and cultivation sustained small settlements, whose inhabitants could move as circumstances changed. The landscape was known through its streams and the places associated with the ancestors.
simp_chinese: 格巴比里位于博祖姆以东的格巴亚人地区。格巴亚社群按父系追溯血缘，家庭通过祈祷和分享猎物的仪式敬奉祖先。狩猎、采集和耕作维持着小型聚落，居民也会随环境变化迁徙。人们通过溪流和与祖先相联系的地点认识周围的土地。

sources.title: 278779940 La notion de 'migration' dans l'aire gbaya

english: Gbêpleu is associated with the forest country around Man in western Côte d'Ivoire, home to the Dan people. A sacred grove bearing the name preserves a place of ritual significance amid the surrounding hills. The Dan have long maintained social and religious traditions rooted in the forests of the Upper Guinea region.
simp_chinese: 格贝普留与科特迪瓦西部曼城附近的森林地区有关，这里是丹人的家园。一片以此命名的圣林坐落在周围丘陵中，保留着具有仪式意义的地点。丹人长期维持着扎根于上几内亚森林的社会与宗教传统。

english:
Gdov stands on the Gdovka near its entry into Lake Peipus, guarding the northern approaches to Pskov. In 1431 the people of Pskov built a new fortress here on a hill between the river and the Staritsa stream. A ditch protected its more exposed side, and both Pskov's treasury and local landholders contributed to the work. The stronghold became an important point on the frontier with Livonia.

In 1480 Livonian forces attacked by night, besieged Gdov and burned its trading settlement. Further wars brought Polish and Swedish armies to its walls. Sweden eventually took the town in 1614, and it returned to Russian control after the Treaty of Stolbovo and the subsequent settlement of the frontier. A fire damaged the fortress in 1698; its defences were strengthened during Peter I's wars. As Russia's border moved west after the Great Northern War, Gdov ceased to serve as a frontier fortress, though its walls remained above the river.
simp_chinese:
格多夫位于格多夫卡河接近佩普西湖的地方，守卫普斯科夫的北方通道。1431年，普斯科夫人在河流与斯塔里察溪之间的山丘上建立新堡垒。较易受攻击的一侧以壕沟保护，普斯科夫国库和当地土地持有人共同承担了建造费用。这座据点成为与利沃尼亚接壤边境上的重要堡垒。

1480年，利沃尼亚军队夜袭格多夫，围攻堡垒并焚毁城外商人聚落。此后的战争又将波兰和瑞典军队带到城墙下。瑞典于1614年最终夺取城镇，斯托尔博沃和约及随后的边界划定使其重归俄罗斯。1698年的火灾损坏了堡垒，彼得一世的战争期间防御工事得到加强。大北方战争后，俄罗斯边界向西推移，格多夫不再是边境堡垒，但城墙依然矗立在河流上方。

english:
Lake Gé is Gehu, also called West Ge Lake or Shazi Lake, between Wujin and Yixing. Ming accounts describe it as part of a connected water system receiving water from Tao Lake and passing it eastward towards Taihu. Channels also linked its shores with the Grand Canal, making the lake one part of the larger network around Changzhou.

The Ming hydraulic treatise San Wu shui kao records the dredging of Baihe Creek in the sixth year of Wanli, 1578. The creek connected the canal to the north with Gehu to the south and with waterways towards Danyang. Such named channels and recorded works give the lake a history of water management: its connections depended on maintaining passages through the densely interlinked rivers and lakes of southern Jiangsu.
simp_chinese:
葛湖对应武进与宜兴之间的滆湖，又称西滆湖、沙子湖。明代水利文献将它记作连贯水系的一部分：西纳洮湖来水，向东通入太湖，另有河港将湖岸与大运河相连。滆湖因而置身于常州周围更大的水路网络中。

明代《三吴水考》记载，白鹤溪于万历六年，即1578年开浚。这条溪流北接运河，向南进入滆湖，并与通往丹阳方向的水道相接。具体河港及其疏浚记录，展现出滆湖的水利历史：在苏南河湖密布的地区，湖泊与外部水系的联系，有赖于这些通道的维护。

english:
Geawegal is a recorded name for Aboriginal people of the Hunter Valley, inland from the coast of New South Wales; it seems to mean “no-sayers”, after the word for “no” in their speech. Norman Tindale placed their country along the northern Hunter tributaries, including Muswellbrook, Aberdeen, Scone and the Mount Royal Range, while Rusden described them as living for twenty-five to thirty miles along the valley on each side of Glendon.

They married with the people of Maitland and, to some extent, those of the Paterson River. They greatly feared the Gamilaraay, who were said to push down from the upper Hunter and raid their country as far as Jerrys Plains. They used heralds to carry messages to other, sometimes distant, peoples, and these messengers were allowed free passage even among hostile groups. In 1831 Thomas Mitchell sketched Cambo, recorded as a Geawegal man.
simp_chinese:
吉亚维加尔是新南威尔士亨特河谷原住民的记录名称，似乎意为“说不的人”，因其语言中表示“不”的词而得名。诺曼·廷代尔把其土地置于亨特河北部支流一带，包括马斯韦尔布鲁克、阿伯丁、斯康和皇家山脉；拉斯登则称他们沿河谷在格伦登两侧各延伸二十五至三十英里。

他们同梅特兰的居民通婚，在一定程度上也与帕特森河一带的居民通婚。据说他们十分畏惧从亨特河上游南下、劫掠到杰里斯平原的加米拉罗伊人。他们使用传令人向其他有时相距遥远的人群传话，这些信使即使在敌对群体中也可自由通行。1831年，托马斯·米切尔画下被记为吉亚维加尔人的坎博。

english: The Geba estuary opens into a maze of waterways behind the Bissagos Islands. Its river connected Atlantic vessels with inland trading routes, and the port of Geba became a meeting place for merchants from the coast and the interior. In the seventeenth century traders could have interests at Geba, Cacheu and Farim, moving between the rivers of Upper Guinea. African rulers and Portuguese-descended merchants shaped the terms of this commerce, which included ivory, hides, gold and enslaved people.
simp_chinese: 热巴河口通向比热戈斯群岛后方纵横交错的水道。河流将大西洋船只与内陆商路联系起来，热巴港成为海岸与内陆商人相遇的地方。十七世纪，商人可能同时在热巴、卡谢乌和法林经营，往来于上几内亚各河之间。非洲统治者与葡萄牙裔商人共同塑造贸易条件，交易货物包括象牙、兽皮、黄金及被奴役人口。

english: Gөbөrgәyel is the river known as the Guberlya, which cuts south through the hills of the southern Urals to join the Ural River. Its swift course has carved steep gorges through the Guberlya mountains, with wooded ravines and meadows among the surrounding steppe. In the eighteenth century travellers recorded both the river and the mountains that take their name from it.
simp_chinese: 格贝尔格耶尔即古别尔利亚河，向南切穿南乌拉尔丘陵，汇入乌拉尔河。湍急的河流在古别尔利亚山中刻出陡峭峡谷，周围草原间还有林木覆盖的沟壑与草甸。十八世纪的旅行者曾记述这条河及以它命名的山脉。

english: Gechak lies in the mountain country of Nangchen, an eastern Tibetan region on the upper Mekong. Nangchen was once a kingdom of Kham, formed from a confederation of tribes in the thirteenth century. Its religious landscape was particularly associated with the Kagyu traditions of Tibetan Buddhism, and its valleys supported communities linked to the kingdom and its monasteries.
simp_chinese: 格察位于囊谦山地，地处湄公河上游的藏地东部。囊谦曾是康区的一个王国，于十三世纪由部落联盟形成。当地宗教传统与藏传佛教噶举派关系尤为密切，山谷中的社群与王国及其寺院保持着联系。

english:
Gecheng was the old name of Anzhou, west of Xinan in the Baiyangdian country of northern China. The two towns remained distinct administrative centres through centuries of changes to their boundaries and rank. Gecheng's position beside this network of lakes and rivers gave water a direct place in the town's built history. During the middle of the Wanli reign, its walls were rebuilt with large bricks over a compacted lime-earth foundation. Local tradition held that closing the gates could keep floodwater outside.

The walled town also belonged to the scholarly culture of the capital region. The Chen family's three successful metropolitan examination graduates became a notable part of Anzhou's Qing history. Official service and examination learning thus accompanied the practical work of maintaining a settlement among waterways. The old name Gecheng and the later name Anzhou referred to this same town, rather than to the separate county seat at Xinan.
simp_chinese:
葛城是白洋淀地区安州的旧称，位于新安以西。两座城镇长期各有治所，在辖境与行政等级多次变更中维持各自身份。葛城身处河湖交织的地带，水患直接影响城池营建。明万历中期，城墙以三合土为基础、用大砖修筑；地方相传，洪水来时关闭城门，可以将水挡在城外。

这座城池也参与京畿地区的科举文化。清代陈氏一门三进士，成为安州地方史中著名的人物。应试求学、出仕为官，与水乡城镇日常的维护经营共同构成这里的生活。葛城与后来的安州，指向同一座城镇，同另有治所的新安并非一地。

english: Gediz lies below Murat Dağı in the uplands between Kütahya and the western Anatolian valleys. Ancient Kadoi occupied this country, close to Mount Dindymon, associated with the worship of the mother goddess Cybele. The later town stood at the edge of a plain where routes led toward Uşak and İzmir. Hot springs and streams emerge from the surrounding mountain slopes, adding to the resources of the district.
simp_chinese: 盖迪兹位于穆拉特山下的高地，介于屈塔希亚与安纳托利亚西部河谷之间。古代卡多伊位于这一地区，靠近与母神库柏勒崇拜有关的丁迪蒙山。后来的城镇坐落在平原边缘，道路通向乌沙克和伊兹密尔。温泉与溪流从周围山坡涌出，丰富了当地资源。

english: Geelong lies beside the sheltered waters of Corio Bay, in the country of the Wadawurrung people. Rivers and grasslands connect the bay with the volcanic plains of western Victoria. In the 1830s colonists entered the Port Phillip district; a settlement at Geelong followed on land where Aboriginal communities had long maintained their own relationships and gathering places.
simp_chinese: 吉朗位于科里奥湾的庇护水域旁，是瓦达沃隆人的土地。河流与草原将海湾同维多利亚西部火山平原相连。1830年代，殖民者进入菲利普港地区，随后在吉朗建立聚落；此前原住民社群早已在这里维系自己的社会关系与会聚地点。

english:
Geertruidenberg takes its name from Saint Gertrude of Nivelles and stands near the meeting of the Donge and the Amer. Count William I of Holland granted it town rights in 1213, making it an early privileged town of his county. Its fortified centre became a place of trade and negotiation for counts and nobles, with a castle built nearby in the 1320s.

The Hook and Cod wars brought repeated sieges: in 1351 the town and castle supported opposing factions, and another siege in 1420 caused great damage. The Saint Elizabeth's flood of 1421 dealt a further blow to its prosperity. During the Dutch Revolt, a mixed English, French Huguenot and Flemish force took the town in 1573. Its English garrison surrendered it to Parma in 1589, but Maurice of Nassau recaptured it in 1593.
simp_chinese:
海尔特勒伊登贝赫以尼韦勒的圣格特鲁德命名，位于东赫河与阿默河汇合处附近。荷兰伯爵威廉一世于1213年授予它城市权利，使它成为伯国较早获得特权的城镇之一。设防的城镇成为贸易以及伯爵和贵族商议事务的场所，附近又在十四世纪二十年代建起城堡。

钩党与鳕党战争带来多次围攻：1351年，城镇与城堡分别支持敌对派别；1420年的另一次围城造成严重破坏。1421年的圣伊丽莎白洪水又打击了当地繁荣。荷兰起义期间，一支由英格兰人、法国胡格诺派和佛兰德人组成的军队于1573年夺取此城。1589年，英格兰守军将城镇交给帕尔马公爵；拿骚的毛里茨于1593年将其收复。

english:
Gefle stands at the mouth of the Gavleån on the Gulf of Bothnia, where a harbour connects Gästrikland with the Baltic. Its merchants shipped iron and copper from the inland mining districts, while fishermen sailed north along the Norrland coast for the seasonal herring catch. The town became an important meeting place for the products of forest, mine and sea.

Gefle was recorded as a town in 1413 and received royal privileges in 1446. Its merchants obtained explicit rights to domestic and foreign trade in 1491. Despite restrictions intended to favour Stockholm, the port grew into a major centre of export in the sixteenth century. Crown shipbuilding and the shipment of copper, timber, tar and iron added to its importance. In the seventeenth century the ironworks of Gästrikland benefited from the town's established commercial connections, sending bar iron through its harbour to markets across the Baltic and beyond.
simp_chinese:
耶夫勒坐落在加夫勒河注入波的尼亚湾的河口，港口将耶斯特里克兰与波罗的海连接。商人运出内陆矿区的铁和铜，渔民则沿诺尔兰海岸北上，参加季节性鲱鱼捕捞。这座城镇成为森林、矿山和海洋产品的重要汇集地。

1413年，耶夫勒已见于城镇记载，1446年获得王室特权，1491年商人又明确取得国内和海外贸易权。尽管有旨在扶持斯德哥尔摩的限制，港口在十六世纪仍发展为重要出口中心。王室造船以及铜、木材、焦油和铁的运输增加了它的地位。十七世纪，耶斯特里克兰的铁厂利用城镇既有商业联系，将条铁经港口运往波罗的海及更远市场。

english: Gegen is the country of the Genhe, called Gegen Gol in Mongolian, a name understood as “clear river”. Rising in the Greater Khingan, it winds southwest through forested mountains towards the Argun. Its lower course spreads into wetlands before joining the larger river near Heishantou. The long valley brings water from the cold northern forests to the grasslands and floodplains of the upper Argun.
simp_chinese: 格根是根河流经的地区。根河的蒙古语名葛根高勒被解释为“清澈的河”，它发源于大兴安岭，蜿蜒向西南流过森林山地，接近黑山头时在湿地中汇入额尔古纳河。漫长的河谷将寒冷北方林地的水带向额尔古纳河上游的草原和泛滥平原。

english: Gegong is a monastic place in Dzachuka, the high pastoral region of the upper Yalong River in eastern Tibet. Its monastery is associated with the Longchen Nyingtik tradition of the Nyingma school. The broad grazing lands and valleys of Dzachuka contain several related religious foundations, serving communities dispersed across a landscape of mountains and open highland pasture.
simp_chinese: 格公是藏地东部扎曲卡的一处寺院所在地，扎曲卡是雅砻江上游的高原牧区。格公寺与宁玛派龙钦宁提传承相联系。这片地区宽广草场与河谷之间分布着数座相关寺院，为散居山地和高原牧场的社群提供宗教中心。

english: Gegou lies in the Yi River valley between the hill country of Yishui and the plains around Linyi. The Yi descends from the mountains to the north and flows south through this district, joined here by the Tang River. The broad valley opens out below the steep ridges of the Yimeng uplands. Villages and fields occupy the land beside the water, while the river continues onward toward the lower Huai basin.
simp_chinese: 葛沟位于沂水山地与临沂平原之间的沂河谷地。沂河从北面的山中流来，南行经过此地，附近还有汤河相汇。沂蒙高地的陡峻山岭向南渐渐让位于开阔河谷，村落和田地分布在水边，河水则继续流向淮河下游流域。

english: The Geiyo Islands lie between Honshu and Shikoku in the Seto Inland Sea, amid narrow channels and powerful tides. In the age of the warring states, the Murakami maritime families made these islands their base. Their knowledge of the currents helped them guide vessels and control passage through the sea. The three Murakami houses also joined forces in battle, defeating a fleet aligned with Oda Nobunaga at the first Battle of Kizugawaguchi.
simp_chinese: 艺予群岛位于本州与四国之间的濑户内海，岛屿间水道狭窄，潮流湍急。战国时代，村上海上势力以群岛为据点，凭借对潮流的熟悉引导船只，掌控海上通行。村上三家也曾联合作战，在第一次木津川口之战中击败织田信长一方的船队。

english: Gelanggi is a name remembered in Malay tradition for an ancient fortified place in the peninsula's interior. Stories of Kota Gelanggi speak of an old city hidden in forest, remembered as a place of great antiquity. The Johor uplands are crossed by rivers descending through wooded hills toward the sea, amid the routes that connected inland communities with the coast.
simp_chinese: 葛浪义在马来传统中是一处半岛内陆古代城寨的名字。关于葛浪义城的故事讲述一座隐藏在森林中的古城。柔佛高地的河流穿过林木覆盖的山丘流向大海，内陆社群沿着这些水道与海岸保持联系。

english:
Geldern grew beside a castle at a crossing of the Niers and gave its name to the county and later duchy of Guelders. The counts made the castle their residence, and the town received rights in 1229. Walls, moats and gates protected the settlement; a Carmelite monastery and the late Gothic church of Mary Magdalene reflected its importance as a ducal centre.

After 1543 Geldern came under Spanish rule. Dutch forces occupied it in 1578, but Spain recovered it in 1587. During the War of the Spanish Succession, a Prussian siege began in February 1703 and ended with the town's surrender in December. The Treaty of Utrecht divided the former Spanish Upper Quarter of Guelders, and Geldern became the administrative seat of its Prussian share. Frederick II ordered the fortifications demolished in 1764.
simp_chinese:
盖尔登兴起于尼尔斯河渡口的一座城堡旁，并为海尔德伯国及后来的公国提供了名称。伯爵以城堡为驻地，城镇于1229年获得城市权。城墙、壕沟和城门保护着聚落；加尔默罗会修道院和晚期哥特式抹大拉的马利亚教堂则体现了它作为公国中心的地位。

1543年后，盖尔登归西班牙统治。荷兰军于1578年占领城市，西班牙于1587年收复。西班牙王位继承战争期间，普鲁士自1703年2月开始围城，直到12月城市才投降。乌得勒支条约瓜分原属西班牙的海尔德上区，盖尔登成为普鲁士所得部分的行政驻地。1764年，腓特烈二世下令拆除城防。

english: Geledi lies in the Haud, near the grazing country of Boh and Danot. Thorn scrub and grass cover this dry plateau; seasonal rains fill natural hollows and allow herds to disperse across the pasture. In dry weather, shallow wells near Geladi offer water, though their supply is limited.
simp_chinese: 格莱迪位于豪德高原，靠近博赫与达诺特的牧场。荆棘灌丛和草地覆盖着干燥的高原；季雨使天然洼地积水，牲畜得以分散到各处牧场。旱季时，盖拉迪附近的浅井提供水源，但供水有限。

english:
Gelendzhik Bay offered a sheltered anchorage on the Circassian coast of the northeastern Black Sea. In the early nineteenth century, maritime trade linked this shore with Ottoman ports while Russian forces sought to interrupt those connections. The Treaty of Adrianople in 1829 strengthened Russia's territorial claims, but the neighbouring Circassian communities continued to resist submission.

In July 1831 a Black Sea squadron entered the bay. After surveying the shore, troops under Major-General Yermolai Berkhman landed on Tolsty Cape and began establishing the Gelendzhik fortification. The anchorage was intended to support the military occupation of the coast and communications across the mountains towards the Kuban. Its potential encouraged further plans: following a reconnaissance in 1836, General Velyaminov proposed an extensive fortress and facilities for repairing ships. This remained a project, not an already completed naval base. The bay's history at this stage joined useful shelter for vessels to a contested attempt to turn maritime access into lasting control of an inhabited coast.
simp_chinese:
格连吉克湾是黑海东北切尔克斯海岸的一处避风锚地。十九世纪初，海上贸易将这里与奥斯曼港口相连，俄军则试图切断这些联系。1829年《阿德里安堡条约》加强俄国的领土主张，但邻近切尔克斯社群继续抵抗归附。

1831年7月，黑海舰队进入海湾，勘察岸线后，叶尔莫莱·别尔赫曼少将指挥部队在厚角登陆，开始修筑格连吉克堡。锚地被用于支持海岸军事占领，以及越山通往库班地区的交通。1836年侦察后，韦利亚米诺夫将军进一步提出大规模堡垒与修船设施方案，尚不能视为已建成的海军基地。海湾的避风条件由此与争夺交织：俄军试图把海上通达能力转化为对有人居住海岸的长期控制。

english:
Gällivare lies in the northern forests and fells of Swedish Lapland. Its name derives from the Lule Sámi Jiellovárre, referring to a cleft in the mountain landscape. Iron ore was discovered in the nearby mountain in the 1690s. When trial mining began in 1735, the inhabitants of the district were chiefly Sámi of the Kaitum community.

Sweden's parliament arranged for a church to be built, with households across the kingdom contributing a small silver coin towards its cost, giving the building its familiar name of the One-Öre Church. The wooden church was completed in 1754 beside the Vassara River. Mining and the church brought a new settlement into the region, though the transport of ore from this remote inland district remained a formidable task.
simp_chinese:
耶利瓦勒位于瑞典拉普兰北部的森林和山地中。地名源自吕勒萨米语的「裂谷山」，指当地山势中的一处裂谷。1690年代附近山中发现铁矿；1735年开始试采时，当地居民主要是凯图姆萨米社区的成员。

瑞典议会安排在此建造教堂，王国内各户都捐献一枚小银币作为经费，教堂因此得名「一厄勒教堂」。1754年，瓦萨拉河畔的木教堂竣工。采矿和教堂使新聚落在当地发展，但从偏远内陆运送矿石仍是一项艰巨任务。

english: Gembu lies on the Mambilla Plateau, a high grassland region cut by valleys near the Cameroon border. Mambila communities occupied the plateau and its river valleys, including the Gembu area. The highland landscape differs sharply from the hotter lowlands around it, with wooded valleys providing shelter among the upland grasslands.
simp_chinese: 根布位于曼比拉高原，这片靠近喀麦隆边地的高地草原被河谷切割。曼比拉社群居住于高原及河谷，包括根布一带。高地景观与周围较热的低地截然不同，森林河谷在草原高地之间提供庇护。

english: Gemer lies on the Slaná, beneath the site of the castle that gave its name to the historic county of Gemer. The village is recorded in 1198 as Gomur, while the older fortress served as a centre of royal county administration and guarded routes towards the mining lands of Spiš. The river valley links the wooded hills of Upper Hungary with the wider plain to the south, and the old county name endured after the castle's prominence faded.
simp_chinese: 盖梅尔位于斯拉纳河畔，村庄上方是为历史上的盖梅尔郡赋名的城堡遗址。1198年文书以戈穆尔之名称及村庄；更古老的堡垒曾是皇家郡政中心，并守卫通往斯皮什矿业地区的道路。河谷将上匈牙利的林木丘陵与南方广阔平原相连，即使城堡地位衰落，旧郡名仍延续下来。

english:
Gemerek stood in the central Anatolian country between Kayseri and Sivas, within the wider territory administered by the Ottomans as Bozok. Its early modern scale was modest: sixteenth-century registers place Gemerek among the region's villages, rather than its great urban centres. The surrounding country was undergoing a wider transition as Türkmen communities established more permanent settlements and cultivated former seasonal grounds.

Religious patronage left a more particular mark. The Şahruh Bey mosque at Gemerek dates to approximately 1515–1522, belonging to a network of foundations associated with the Dulkadir ruling family. Mosques, lodges and endowed properties connected their benefactors with settlements across the middle Kızılırmak region. Under Ottoman government, Bozok's administrative affiliations shifted repeatedly before it became firmly attached to the province of Rum in 1560. Gemerek's place in this history was that of a settled community within a changing provincial landscape, shaped by landed endowments and the incorporation of villages into imperial revenue administration.
simp_chinese:
格梅雷克位于开塞利与锡瓦斯之间的安纳托利亚内陆，处在奥斯曼时期博佐克辖区的广大范围内。近世早期，它的规模仍然有限：十六世纪簿册把这里列为村落，尚非区域大城。周围地区正经历土库曼社群逐渐定居、将季节活动地转为长期聚落的变化。

宗教赞助留下了更具体的印记。格梅雷克的沙赫鲁赫贝伊清真寺约建于1515至1522年，属于同杜勒卡迪尔统治家族相联系的一系列宗教基金。清真寺、修道所和捐赠地产，把出资者同克孜勒河中游各聚落连接起来。奥斯曼统治下，博佐克的行政隶属曾反复变动，至1560年稳定归入鲁姆省。格梅雷克是这片不断重组的省区中的定居社群，宗教捐赠与村落纳入帝国税收体系，共同影响其地方生活。

english: Gemona stands where the Tagliamento emerges from the Alps toward the Friulian plain. Its position on the road across the mountains made the town a valuable stronghold; the Lombard historian Paul the Deacon described its castle as impregnable. In 1184 Frederick Barbarossa granted a charter for its market. Gemona later returned to the authority of the patriarchs of Aquileia, whose lands were absorbed by Venice in 1420; after the republic fell, it passed to Austria in 1798.
simp_chinese: 杰莫纳坐落在塔利亚门托河穿出阿尔卑斯山、流向弗留利平原之处。通往山脉另一侧的道路使城镇成为重要据点；伦巴第历史学家保罗执事曾称其城堡坚不可摧。1184年，腓特烈·巴巴罗萨授予当地市场特许状。杰莫纳后来重新归阿奎莱亚宗主教统治，其领地于1420年被威尼斯吞并；共和国覆灭后，此城于1798年转归奥地利。

english: Genç was the name of a district on the upper Murat, a branch of the Euphrates, amid the mountains of eastern Anatolia. After the Ottoman victory at Chaldiran in 1514, the historic settlement of Genç became the centre of a sancak. The river valley connected its fortified places and villages with the wider lands of Diyarbakır, while steep uplands enclosed the routes leading north.
simp_chinese: 根奇是安纳托利亚东部山区穆拉特河上游一处地区的名称，穆拉特河为幼发拉底河的支流。1514年奥斯曼人在查尔迪兰获胜后，历史上的根奇聚落成为一个桑贾克的中心。河谷将设防地点和村庄同更广阔的迪亚巴克尔地区联系起来，陡峭高地则环绕着通往北方的道路。

english:
Gendebelo was a Muslim trading city of Ifat under the Walasma dynasty. Camel caravans brought Indian spices through Adal from the port of Zeila, while ginger was grown locally. The city stood at a meeting of different ways of transport: the Venetian Alessandro Zorzi described it as a place where loads were transferred from mules to camels.

The city appears in the sixteenth-century account of Adal's invasion of Ethiopia, the Futuh al-Habasha. Its inhabitants contributed gold that, according to historian Mohammed Hassen, helped the Adalites acquire weapons before their victory at Shimbra Kure. The wealth of the caravan trade thus reached beyond the market into the wars between Adal and the Christian kingdom. Gendebelo's connections brought distant goods deep into the Ethiopian interior.
simp_chinese:
根德贝洛是伊法特的一座穆斯林商贸城市，受瓦拉斯马王朝统治。骆驼商队从泽拉港经阿达尔运来印度香料，而姜则在当地种植。城镇也是不同运输方式的交汇处：威尼斯作者亚历山德罗·佐尔齐称这里是货物从骡背转到骆驼背上的地方。

十六世纪记述阿达尔入侵埃塞俄比亚的《征服阿比西尼亚》也提到了这座城市。历史学家穆罕默德·哈桑认为，居民贡献的黄金帮助阿达尔军队购买武器，取得希姆布拉库雷战役的胜利。商队贸易积累的财富由此走出市场，进入阿达尔与基督教王国之间的战争。根德贝洛的商路则将远方货物带入埃塞俄比亚内陆深处。

english: Generostee Creek is one of the waterways bearing Indigenous names in the old Cherokee country of the Carolina Piedmont. It runs toward the Savannah River through a landscape later divided into farms. Between 1777 and 1791 the government issued dozens of land grants along Big Generostee Creek, as settlers moved into the district. A Presbyterian congregation established near the creek about 1790 also took the name Generostee.
simp_chinese: 杰内罗斯蒂溪是卡罗来纳皮德蒙特地区保留原住民名字的水道之一，流经切罗基人的旧地，向萨凡纳河而去。这里后来被划为农场。1777年至1791年，随着移民进入这一地区，政府沿大杰内罗斯蒂溪颁发了数十份土地授予。约1790年在溪畔建立的一个长老会教会也以杰内罗斯蒂为名。

english:
Geneseo lies in the valley of the Genesee River, in the country of the Seneca, the westernmost of the original nations of the Haudenosaunee. Nearby stood the Seneca town of Jo'néhsi:yo:h, known to American soldiers as Little Beard's Town. Its houses and fields were among several Seneca settlements in this fertile valley.

In 1779, during the American Revolution, General John Sullivan led an expedition against Haudenosaunee communities allied with the British. His army reached the Genesee valley in September and destroyed Little Beard's Town and its crops, along with other villages. The campaign was intended to weaken Britain's allies after a series of frontier raids. The destruction of homes and food stores forced many inhabitants to seek shelter elsewhere as winter approached.
simp_chinese:
杰尼西奥位于杰尼西河谷，地处塞内卡人的领土。塞内卡是霍迪诺肖尼联盟原有诸族中最西边的一族。附近曾有塞内卡城镇若内西约，美国士兵称其为小胡子镇；它的房屋与田地是这片肥沃河谷中数处塞内卡聚落的一部分。

1779年美国革命期间，约翰·沙利文将军率军远征与英国结盟的霍迪诺肖尼社群。在一系列边疆袭击之后，此次行动旨在削弱英国的盟友。沙利文的军队于九月抵达杰尼西河谷，摧毁了小胡子镇及其作物，也破坏了其他村庄。家园和粮食储备遭到毁坏，迫使许多居民在冬天来临之际到别处寻求庇护。

english:
Geneva stands where the Rhône leaves the lake, at the crossing of roads from Lyon, Italy and Switzerland. The bishop, a prince of the Empire since 1162, held the city against the counts of Geneva and, from the thirteenth century, the house of Savoy, which wanted this rich town as its capital. Merchants and craftsmen first banded together in 1263, and in 1309 the bishop was forced to recognise the commune. Bishop Adhémar Fabri granted the Franchises of 1387, which fixed the election of the syndics. The fairs of Geneva were among the chief marts of Europe at their height in the middle of the fifteenth century, and the Medici of Florence opened a bank here in 1424. In 1462 Louis XI forbade French merchants to attend them in order to favour Lyon, and trade shrank. Jews were confined to a ghetto in 1428 and expelled in 1490.

The Eidguenots, who wanted union with the Swiss, fought the pro-Savoyard Mammelus; Philibert Berthelier was executed in 1519. In 1535 the mass was suspended, and in May 1536 the Reformation was formally adopted. John Calvin arrived that July, was banished in 1538 and returned in September 1541 to draw up the Ecclesiastical Ordinances. Geneva became the “Protestant Rome”: its academy opened in 1559 under Theodore Beza, and refugees from France and Italy doubled the population in the 1550s. On the night of 11 December 1602 the Savoyards failed in the Escalade, and the Treaty of Saint-Julien in 1603 secured the city's independence.

In the eighteenth century the government of the patricians faced the revolts of Pierre Fatio in 1707 and of the burghers in 1737. In 1762 the council ordered Rousseau's Émile and Social Contract burned. The revolution of 1782 gave equal rights to the natives, but French, Sardinian and Bernese troops besieged the city and restored the patricians. Revolutionary France annexed Geneva in 1798, and in 1814 and 1815 it joined the Swiss Confederation.
simp_chinese:
日内瓦位于罗讷河流出湖面之处，里昂、意大利和瑞士方向的道路在此交会。自1162年起，主教是帝国诸侯，他守护这座城市，对抗日内瓦伯爵，以及自13世纪起想把这座富庶城市作为首府的萨伏依家族。商人和工匠于1263年首次结社，1309年主教被迫承认公社。阿德马尔·法布里主教授予1387年的《特许状》，确定了市政长官（syndic）的选举。日内瓦的集市在15世纪中叶达到鼎盛，是欧洲主要的商品交易场所之一，佛罗伦萨的美第奇家族在1424年于此开设银行。1462年，路易十一为扶持里昂，禁止法国商人前来赶集，贸易随之萎缩。1428年犹太人被限居隔离区，1490年被驱逐。

主张与瑞士结盟的“艾德吉诺”（Eidguenots）与亲萨伏依的“马姆吕”（Mammelus）对立，菲利贝尔·贝特利埃于1519年被处决。1535年停止弥撒，1536年5月正式采纳宗教改革。约翰·加尔文同年7月来到日内瓦，1538年被驱逐，1541年9月返回，并起草了《教会法规》。日内瓦成为“新教的罗马”：1559年学院在特奥多尔·贝扎主持下开办，来自法国和意大利的难民在1550年代使人口翻了一番。1602年12月11日夜，萨伏依人的“登城之夜”（Escalade）偷袭失败，1603年《圣朱利安条约》保障了城市独立。

18世纪，寡头执政遭遇1707年皮埃尔·法蒂奥和1737年市民的反抗。1762年，议会下令焚毁卢梭的《爱弥儿》和《社会契约论》。1782年革命赋予原住民平等权利，但法国、撒丁和伯尔尼军队围城，恢复了贵族统治。1798年革命的法国吞并日内瓦，1814至1815年日内瓦加入瑞士邦联。

english: Gěngdāng was a small Tai prefecture in the forested hills northwest of Jǐnghóng, in the Chēlǐ country along the upper Mekong, which the Chinese called the Lancang. The Yuan court set it up as Gěngdāng Zhōu under Chēlǐ Fǔ in 1347. Its separate rule did not last: in 1382 the new Ming government folded it into the Chēlǐ Military and Civil Pacification Commission, whose hereditary Tai Lue rulers governed the whole river country. The hills here were tea and elephant country, and the rulers of Chēlǐ sent tribute to the Chinese court in the form of elephants and silver and gold vessels.
simp_chinese: 耿当是景洪西北林木茂密的丘陵地带上一个傣族小州，属车里地区，澜沧江（湄公河上游）从这一带流过。元朝至正七年（1347年）在此设耿当州，隶车里府。这一单独建置并不长久：1382年明朝初立，便将其并入车里军民宣慰使司，由世袭的傣泐首领统辖整片江河之地。这里的山地盛产茶叶，也是大象出没之处，车里的统治者向中原朝廷进贡大象和金银器皿。

english: Gengma lies in the Nan Ding River basin amid the mountains of southwestern Yunnan. Tai hereditary chiefs governed the Gengma basin and later held part of the neighboring Mengding basin. Local tradition traces the founding of the chiefdom to Han Shuafa and his son Han Xiefa, who crossed the Wa mountains and established settlements here in the late fourteenth century. The chiefdom endured under the Ming and Qing, retaining its own hereditary line of rulers.
simp_chinese: 耿马位于滇西南群山中的南汀河流域。傣族世袭土司治理耿马坝，后来也掌有邻近孟定坝的一部分。地方传说将土司政权的建立追溯到罕刷法与其子罕谢法，他们在十四世纪末越过佤山来到这里开辟村寨。耿马土司历经明清，世袭统治得以延续。

sources.title: 那段充满户南茶香的土司历史.html

english: The Henichesk Strait is a narrow channel at the northern end of the Arabat Spit. It connects the Sea of Azov with the shallow lagoons of the Syvash, which the long sandbar separates from the open sea. Winds influence the movement of water through the passage, while the low banks and shoals make it a place of shifting water levels. Salt collects in the enclosed lagoons to the west.
simp_chinese: 格尼奇斯克水道位于阿拉巴特沙嘴北端，是一条狭窄通道。长长沙洲将亚速海与浅浅的锡瓦什潟湖隔开，水道则使二者相通。风影响水流方向，低平岸边和浅滩的水位随之变化；西面的封闭潟湖中则积聚着盐分。

english: Gennargentu is a great mountain massif in the interior of Sardinia, rising above the island's central and southern valleys. Its rounded heights include Punta La Marmora and Bruncu Spina, the highest summits on the island.
